tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi zab khrid nges don

rgya mtsho'i snying po phrin las 'od 'phro bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs// 'bral med spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs gsol te// nges don rgya mtsho'i snying po zab don 'di// bka' brgyud rin chen gsung bzhin bri bar bya// de'ang 'chi ba mi rtag pas rgyud bskul zhing 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor rig ste tshe 'di blos btang 'gro drug pha ma sha stag yin pa'i nges shes gting tshugs su bskyed de/ de rnams kyi ched du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod cing*/ de'ang tshe gcig lus gcig la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam mthar thug la brten nas sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag tshe phyi ma kho na'i don ched du gnyer ba byung na de la 'di skad ces bstan par bya ste/ khyed rnams zab don gyi snying po nyams su len par 'dod pa de legs/ de la rang rang gi sems kyi 'dod tshul ma shes na khrid 'debs mi shes te/ dper na 'ben ma mthong bar mda' rgyag pa bzhin gar 'gro cha med do// des na sems can gyi khams dbang sna tshogs pas so so'i shes rgyud dang bstun nas ston dgos pa las/ khyed khrid sngon zhu myong ba rnams kyis kyang sngar gyi rgyus yod dang go ba skam po tsam gyis mi chog ste/ bla ma so so la chos lugs re yod pa yin/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi dge bshes rnams kyis kyang gzhung dang bstan bcos kyi tshig ris khyer byon pas mi chog ste 'dir myong thog nas ngo 'phrod nges shes pa dgos pa yin/ de la'ang ngo sprod kyi rigs mang yang da res gzhan spras spros mang po mi byed par nged kyis btab pa'i ngo sprod 'di ga la chig sgril du byas te grub mthas ma bsgyur gnyen pos ma bcos pa'i nyams len mthil phyin pa rgyud thog tu khel nges pa zhig byas nas 'char sgo gang byung gi nyams rtogs khyer shog/

de la bka' brgyud rin po che'i zab khrid nyams su len par byed pa la gang zag gi dbang po'am blo'i rim pa dang bstun nas khrid tshul du ma yod pa las/ rje dwags po rin po ches ni slob ma snod ldan rnams rje mi la nas brgyud pa'i thabs lam gyis khrid/ tshogs pa phal mo che ni bka' gdams nas brgyud pa'i lam rim gyi sgo nas khrid par mdzad cing bka' srol 'di thams cad de'i rjes su 'brang dgos/ bka' gdams nas brgyud pa la'ang rgya chen spyod pa'i rgyud/ zab mo lta ba'i rgyud/ nyams len byin rlabs kyi rgyud pa gsum du yod pa las/ phyi ma 'di tai lo nā ro nas brgyud pas don gyi gnad gcig tu 'bab par nges/ spyir theg pa gsum gang rung du rigs sad pa'i gang zag so so'i lam gong nas gong du khrid par bya bas sa mtshams dang rnam grangs du mar 'gyur mod/ 'dir ni rang don dang tshe 'di'i don gnyer spu tsam med par 'gro drug drin can pha mar shes nas de rnams kyi ched du rdzogs sangs sgrub pa la ches rings pa'i gang zag gis nyams su blang bya'i dbang du byas la/ de ni theg chen gyi rigs can dbang po rno ba dag yin mod/ 'on kyang gang zag gi dbang po na 'pho bas dbang po brtul po las rnon po dang*/ rigs dman cing ma sad pa las rigs mchog sad pa dang*/ gdams ngag gi snod du mi rung ba las snod rung du 'gyur ba srid pas/ de lta bu'i yongs su sbyang bar bya ba'i phyir khrid rim thams cad kyi sngon 'gro'i chos nyams su blangs pas dngos gzhi rgyud la skye ba'i skal pa can du 'gyur ba'o// sngon 'gro'i chos de la'ang ring ba brgyud pa'i dang*/ nye ba dngos kyi sgo nas dbye ba las/ thog ma skyes bu chung 'bring dang*/ phyi ma la skyes bu chen po'i lam du jo bo rjes bshad cing*/ de dang mthun par rje dwags po rin po ches kyang chos bzhir gsungs la/ de dag kyang snga ma snga ma sngon du 'gro dgos/

khrid ston pa la'ang rab rang la 'ang spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mthar phyin cing slob ma'i rgyud tshod shes pa dgos/ de lta min kyang zhus lo thob lo sgom lo tsam du ma bzhag par rang gis rdo rus gtugs nas bsgoms pa'i nyams myong ji ltar 'khrul med du skyes pa de dang sgo bstun nas khrid pa zhig dgos/ gzhan zog po'i 'ur khrid/ 'dod po che'i dpung khrid/ shes chung gi dpe khrid/ sku chen gyi yom khrid rnams spangs la/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i tshig khrid/ sgom chen gyi smar khrid/ rnal 'byor pa'i myong khrid/ rtogs ldan gyi dgongs khrid/ rgan mo'i mdzub khrid rnams ni don dang mthun no/ /khrid nyams su len pa de'ang le lo g.yeng ba'i rkyen gyis ma khyer bar bya dgos te/ rang gi rig pa 'di col chung*/ phyi rol gyi dngos po 'di bkrag che zhing bslu brid la mkhas pas kho'i dbang du shor dogs yod/ de mi 'chor ba'i phyir sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum rim gyis ston dgos pa las/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro dang gsum las/ dang po thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgom pa bzhi yin pa las/ dang po ni/ thog mar dal 'byor rnyed dka'i go ba dang nges pa rnyed pa dgos pas thar rgyan las/ rten ni mi lus rin chen mchog /ces pa ltar/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che zhes pa mngon mtho nges legs sgrub par mi khom pa'i bya ba ngan pas dal bas na dal ba/ mngon mtho nges legs sgrub pa'i bya ba phun sum tshogs pas 'byor pas na 'byor pa'o/ /yang na dge ba la mos pa dal ba/ dge ba lag tu len pas 'byor pa'o/ /yang na mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad spangs pas dal ba/ 'byor ba bcu dang ldan pas 'byor ba zhes gsungs pa'o/ /mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad ni/

chos mngon par/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*/ /kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa/ /lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad// ces dang*/ 'byor ba bcu ni/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*/ /las mtha' ma log gnas la dad// ces rang 'byor lnga dang*/ sangs rgyas byon dang chos bstan dang*/ /bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug/ gzhan phyir snying ni brtse ba'o/ /zhes gzhan 'byor lnga ste bcu'o// de rnams la dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ldan gyi mi lus rin po che zhes bya ba yin no/ /rnyed par dka' zhing phan thogs che bas rin po che dang chos mtshungs pa'i phyir rin po che zhes bya/ khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i lam tshe gcig la byang chub sgrub pa ni nges par lho 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi lus khams drug dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i lus 'di kho na yin zhing 'di lta bu ni sngon dge ba spyad cing sdig pa spangs tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin pas de lta bu ni shin tu nas dkon pa'o/ /gang la ltos nas rnyed par dka' na mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad kyi nang nas dam pa'i chos sgrub tu yod pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di shin tu dkon pas da lam chos byar yod pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus 'di nyin mo'i skar ma lta bu yin zhing*/ gang rnyed par dka' na dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di'o/ /tshul gang gis rnyed par dka' na/ ngan song gsum ni sa chen po'i rdul phran bzhin dang mi lus tsam po pa'ang sen mo'i steng gi rdul lta bu yin pa las da lam mi lus mchog thob pa 'di/ rgya mtsho cher g.yengs gnya' shing gi/ bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar// mi nyid rnyed pa shin tu dka'/ /zhes dang*/ tsan+d+ra go mis kyang*/ gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho'i mthar 'byin zhing*// byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs byed pa// yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan ches lhag pa'i//

mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed// sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa// lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang*// mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi 'am ci dang lto 'phyes min// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka'// skyes bus don grub thob par gyur pa la// zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ mi gyur pa ni dka' ba ste/ /mi srog thob pa'ang dka' ba yin// dam pa'i chos thob dka' ba ste/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba'ang dka' ba yin// zhes dang*/ snying rje pad dkar las kyang*/ mir skye ba ni rnyed par dka'/ dal ba phun sum tshogs pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ dge ba'i chos la 'dun pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ yang dag pa'i smon lam yang rnyed par dka' lags so/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud rnams las mtha' yas par gsungs pa dang mthun pa'o/ /de'ang lus la gru dang 'og rta dang g.yog gi 'du shes bzhag la 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho dang 'phrang las bsgral zhing 'bros/ dge ba'i las la bkol dgos te/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol// gru 'di phyis nas rnyed par dka'/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log /ces dang*/ mi lus gtsang ma'i rta zhon nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'phrang las bros// zhes dang*/ mi 'o cog gi lus 'di ni/ /bkol bar bya ba nyid du zad// ces gsungs so/ /ltar snang la mi lus skyon med du snang yang rgyud la dad pa'i blo mi 'char ba ni dal 'byor ltar snang dud 'gro mi'i byad gzugs 'dzin pa dang chos mtshungs/ rgyud la dad pa'i blo yod na 'phral gyi dbang po tshang ma tshang cung zad la ma ltos pas rten mchog yin te phal chen las/ srid pa'i gnas can dad pa chung ba yis/ /sangs rgyas byang chub shes par mi nus so/ /zhes dang*/ mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i yon tan mi skye ste//

sa bon me yis tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po ji bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas so/ /mdo las/ kun dga' bo dad pa la sbyor bar gyis shig /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pas gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ dad pa'ang chos mngon pa las/ dad pa gang zhe na/ las dang 'bras bu dang bden pa dang dkon mchog la mngon par yid ches pa dang 'dod pa dang sems dang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pas dang ba'i dad pa/ yid ches pa'i dad pa/ 'dod pa'i dad pa rnams su yod pa las/ dang po ni/ yul dkon mchog la brten te dkon mchog gsum dang bla mar mos shing sems dang ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu 'dod khams kyi bde ba dang*/ mi dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal/ mi g.yo ba'i las kyi 'bras bu khams gong gi bde ba/ las dang nyon mongs pa la brten nas 'bras bu sdug bden gyi zag bcas kyi phung po lnga thob par yid ches pa ste mdor na las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i ched du gus pa dang bcas te lam la slob pa'o/ /rin chen phreng bar/ 'dun dang zhe sdang 'jigs pa dang*/ /rmongs pas gang zhig chos mi 'da'// de ni dad pa can zhes bya/ /nges par legs pa'i snod mchog yin// zhes chags sdang rmongs gsum sogs kyi sgo nas chos mi gtong ba'ang dad par 'jog go /phan yon ni skyes bu mchog gi sems skye/ mi khom pa brgyad spong ba sogs mtha' yas shing*/ dad pa yod na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang de'i drung du byon nas chos ston te/ dkon mchog ta lar/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed pa// byang chub bla na med la dad gyur na// skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye 'o/ /zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ de ltar dad pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi snod du rig nas de'i drung du gshegs te byang chub sems dpa'i lam yang dag par ston to/

/zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar mi lus thob cing dad pa'i blo dang ldan pa'i skabs 'dir mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi bya bas chud ma gzan par dge sbyor la nan tan du bya dgos/ gzhan du na lus ngag gi sdig pa mngon gyur pa ma bsags kyang yid kyis mi dge ba'i sems mgo mi non par 'khor yug tu 'char ba'i rnam smin gyis skye ba phyi ma gar skye cha ma 'tshal te/ dge ba dag kyang ma byas la/ /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na// bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs shing*/ mi khom pa'i gnas rnams su lhung na ji ltar bya/ des na dal 'byor 'di thob dka' zhing 'jig sla la phan yon du ma dang ldan pa'i go ba dang nges shes rnal ma rgyud la ma skyes bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /dal 'byor thob dka' bar shes kyang dge sbyor la brtson par mi byed na rnyed par dka' ba rnyed pa la dgos pa ci zhig yod pas mgo la me shor ba gsod pa ltar brtson pa chen pos nyin mtshan med par thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad pa dang bslab gsum mig ltar bsrung zhing byang chub kyi sems la nan tan du bya ba gal che'o// mdor bsdus nas bsgom bya ni/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob par dka' zhing 'jig par sla bas nyi ma de ring nas dge sbyor la ltem rkyang med par khor yug tu bya snyam du bsam mo/ /dmigs pa dang chos thun dang po'o// gnyis pa 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa ni/ ston pas/ dge slong dag 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing ji ltar mi rtag na/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ bsags pa kun gyi mtha' 'dzad cing*/ /bslang ba'i tha ma 'gyel bar 'gyur// phrad pa'i tha ma 'bral ba ste/ /gson pa'i tha ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ kye ma 'dus byas rnams mi rtag /skye zhing 'jig pa'i chos can yin// zhes gsungs pas 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing 'gyur bas tshe srog kyang mi rtag go

/de yang phyi'i 'jig rten la 'ang bskal pa chags 'jig gnas gsum lo zla zhag za ma snga dro phyi dro nyin mtshan dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba sogs skad cig re rer yang 'gyur zhing mi rtag ste/ rgya rol las/ srid gsum mi rtag nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra/ /zhes gsungs so/ /nang bcud kyi sems can rnams kyang skyes pa nas rgas pa sogs sgo gsum skad cig kyang mi sdod par 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin du gnas/ khyad par lho 'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi tshe tshad la nges pa med pas glo bur gyi rkyen du mas nges med du 'chi bar 'gyur te/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ kha cig mngal du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin kha cig btsas pa'i sar// de bzhin kha cig gog tsam na/ /de bzhin kha cig yongs rgyug pa'i// la la rgan dang la la gzhon/ /la la dar la bab pa'i mi// rim gyis rab tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so// 'chi ba thog tu bab pa'i tshe tshe 'di'i dpal 'byor snyan grags stobs 'byor gang gis kyang mi phan zhing phyis gnod pa'i rgyu byas pas don med stong ro dang 'chi khar yang de dag gi sems khral sna tshogs rgyud la skye ste/ 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na/ /bu rnams skyabs su mi 'gyur zhing*// pha yang ma yin gnyen 'dun min/ /khyod la skyabs su 'gyur ba med//

ces gsungs pas so/ /de'ang bdag nges par 'chi/ nam 'chi cha med par myur du 'chi/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i long med par 'chi/ mi 'dod bzhin du bya ba mthar ma phyin par 'chi/ tshe 'di'i longs spyod btsan phyug stobs 'byor gang gis kyang mi phan par 'chi'o/ /nges par 'chi ba'i rgyu mtshan yang sngar rang gi pha ma khyim mtshes yul mi dgon pa ri khrod gnas gzhi na gnas pa'i gnyen 'brel mthun grogs ngo shes ji snyed yod pa de dag tshe 'di don du gnyer nas rtsol ba brtson 'grus sdod tshis kyi grabs shoms ji tsam byas kyang thog tu ma song ma zin par kho shi mo shi zhes sogs zer ba rkyang pa red cing*/ sngar byung ba/ da lta yod pa/ slad nas 'byung ba'i sems can su yang mi 'chi bar sdod pa gcig kyang med/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sku yang 'jig na 'o skol lta ci smos/ de skad du yang slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis/ sa 'am 'on te mtho ris na/ /skyes nas la la ma shi ba// 'ga' zhig khyod kyis mthong ba 'am/ /thos sam 'on te the tshom za/ /zhes dang*/ ji snyed sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i// rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /chu shing snying po med 'dra ba'i// lus can gzhan la lta ci smos// zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs so/ /myur du 'chi zhing nam 'chi cha med de/ mdzod las/ 'di na ma nges tha mar ni/ /lo bcu dang po dpag tu med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'o skol 'dzam gling pa'i tshe la nges pa med cing deng sang lnga bcu kha ral gyi skabs su 'dug/ de'ang glo bur gyi rkyen dug gza' la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis do dgong gson po nyal ba'i shul du sang shi ba'i ro yong ba'ang mthong bas nges pa med cing lo zla ba zhag sogs ji tsam song rim nas 'chi bar nye ba yin pas ma tshor ba zhig la 'chi ba thog tu 'ong*/ rtsal po ches mda' 'phangs pa'am ri gzar nas chu 'bab pa'am gsod sar khrid pa'i btson bzhin myur du 'chi ste/

dper na skyes bu rtsal chen gyis/ /rgyud la springs nas mda' bskul ba// mi sdod bsdigs sar myur du phyin/ /mi rnams tshe yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang*/ 'dus pa las/ grogs dag tshe 'di myur 'gro zhing*/ /ri gzar chu drag mgyogs 'gro na// byis pa'i skye bos mi shes te/ /mi mkhas longs spyod dregs pas myos// zhes dang*/ ljon shing gi mdor/ gsod sar khrid pa'i btson bzhin du/ /gom re bor zhing 'chi dang nye/ /zhes dang*/ tshoms las/ dper na nges par gsod pa dag /gom pa gang dang gang bor ba// gsod pa'i drung du bsnyen pa ltar/ /mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no// zhes gsungs so/ /sdig pa sbyong ba'i long med par 'chi ste/ tshe la nges pa med cing 'chi rkyen mang gson rkyen nyung gson rkyen yang 'chi rkyen du 'gyur ba srid pa'i phyir te/ bshes spring las/ tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa lta'i// chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na// dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las// sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che/ /zhes dang*/ rin chen phreng bar/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste/ /gson pa nyid kyis de lta min// de rnams nyid ni 'chi ba'i yang*/ /de bas rtag tu chos mdzod cig/ ces dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar/ /sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi/ /zhes dang*/ de ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin// bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung*// zhes gsungs so/ /chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba ma tshar ma zin bya bzhag rnams rim gyis bya dgos snyam pa'i ngang la mi 'dod bzhin du 'chi bdag thog tu sleb yong bas tshe 'di'i don mi sgrub cing phyi ma'i don sgrub dgos te/ sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma gnyis/ /sngun la gang yong gtol med pas/ /sang gi tshis la mi 'bad par/ /phyi ma'i don la 'bad par rigs/ /zhes dang*/

spyod 'jug las/ nyin mtshan sdod pa yong med par/ /tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing*// snon pa gud nas yong med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ /zhes so// dpa' zhing rtsal che la gze zhing bang mgyogs smra mchu bde zhing longs spyod btsan phyug stobs 'byor ji tsam 'dzom yang 'chi ba bzlog mi thub/ 'chi dus sngar gyi las gang byas kyi 'bras bu ma gtogs thams cad phyi la bzhag ste mar gyi nang nas spu bton pa bzhin du sgren mo lag stong du 'gro /da lta lus na mi bzod ltogs mi bzod 'khyags mi bzod skom mi bzod/ brgyab kyi dogs bsad kyi dogs bcings kyi dogs bzung gi dogs lus kyi 'tsho skyong kho na'i ched du sdug bsngal dka' dgu spyad pa 'di shi tshe thams cad kyis skyug bro lta rgyab kyis phyogs longs spyod rnams ni thob sha byed/ lus de thag pas bcings dur khrod du bskyal bya gcan gzan rnams kyis zos rus pa tsam las sngar gyi shul tsam yang med par byed/ yang na mer bsregs thal ba spar gang byed dam chur skyur nya sbal gyis za'am sa 'og tu 'bu nyog ge sba/ gnas tshul de las ma 'das pas dus de tsa na dkar po dge ba'i las dang dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs skyabs skyel ma med pas de tsa na mi 'gyod pa'i blo bde tshags su tshud pa gal che'o/ /de skad du'ang spyod 'jug las/ bdag ni mal du 'dug bzhin du/ /gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor yang*// srog chad pa yi tshor ba ni/ /bdag nyid kho nas myong bar 'gyur// gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la/ /gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan// de tshe bsod nams gcig skyabs na/ /de yang bdag gis ma bsten to/ /zhes dang*/ dka' ba mang pos bsgrubs pa yi/ /zas dang gos kyis bskyangs pa'i lus// khyod dang mi 'grogs bya khyis za/ /yang na 'bar ba'i me yis 'tshig/ yang na chu yi nang du 'drul/ /yang na sa yi dong du sba// zhes gsungs so/

/chos thun dang dmigs thun gnyis pa'o// ༈ 'chi tshul dngos kyang me chu dug mtshon gza' sogs kyis glo bur du 'chi ba'am yang na 'ga' zhig yun ring nad kyis btab rim gro sman dpyad byas kyang ma phan lus sems bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis non/ gtam gyi shed shor/ zas kyis phan yang dang khar mi 'gro/ skom 'thung 'dod kyang sman pas bkag /a na hu khyu'i sgra 'byin/ nub gnyid mi yong*/ nyin dbang med du 'thibs/ mal gyi tha mar nyal/ zas kyi tha ma khar snyod/ gtam gyi tha ma 'or skyed byed/ gdong la rdul chags/ gos la nom nom 'ju/ sa 'og tu lhung ba snyam byed/ dbugs kha nas bsho zhing phyir ldog pa med par mig skya log ger shi/ lus de dur sa zhig tu bskyal/ lus dang bral ba'i sems de rang gis bsags pa'i las kyi rjes su bar dor dbang med 'phyo/ las dbang gis phyi ma'i skye gnas 'dzin no/ /de 'ang mdo las/ 'jig rten 'di ni 'dor/ 'jig rten pha rol du ni 'gro/ skyas chen pos ni 'degs/ mun pa chen por ni zhugs/ pha ma phu nu sring mo bu bu mos ni bskor/ dbugs ni chad/ nor rnams ni bgo bsha' byed zer/ kyi hud pha kyi hud ma kyi hud bu zhes ni zer/ skra ni bshig /de'i tshe chos ma gtogs skyabs dang gnas dang dpung gnyen gzhan med do/ /de'i dus na chos ni gling dang mgon dang gnas dang ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du 'gyur ro// gzhan yang sngon byon gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyang mi rtag pas thugs rgyud bskul tshe 'di blos btang sgrub pa snying por mdzad pas don gnyis mthar phyin pa yin pas/ jo bo rje dang*/ lo chen rin bzang dang*/ chag khri mchog /a mes byang chub shes rab rdo rje/ 'dzeng sgom dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ po to ba/ kha rag pa sogs kyi mkhas grub du ma mi rtag pas thugs rgyud bskul long med kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas dngos grub brnyes pa yin/

rang re rnams zas gos yod pas mi chog legs pa zhig dgos nor la bed spyod rgyu yod pas mi chog phugs thes dgos/ byas kyang rung ma byas kyang rung ba'i chos de 'chi ba snying gzer la byed par snang*/ shes pa rnal du yod byas na ci 'dra ang bsam nas bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar la slob pa gal che/ des na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po las kyang chos tshig gcig ston pa'i dge bshes grogs su bzang*/ pho brang skyed tshal rin chen sna bdun sogs kyis spras pa las sa rdo'i spyil por sgo gsum mi dge bas dben par bsdad na gnas bzang*/ nor ji tsam 'dzom pa las 'dod chung chog shes nor du che bas lag tu blang ba gal che/ des na nam 'chi cha med bsams la blo sna bstungs/ skyo shas bskyed/ long med kyi bsam pa drag pos nyin mtshan dge sbyor gyis dus 'da' zhing dgos med kyi blo sna thung sbud kyi ma song bar 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgom pa gal che zhing 'chi ba mi rtag pa'i go ba dang nges shes rgyud la ma skyes na dgos med kyi blo mi skye/ de ma skyes na dge sbyor la brtson pa mi byed par le lor lus 'gro bas dge sbyor yong mi yong 'di la rag las so// mdor bsdus nas bsgom bya ni/ skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba ma gtogs med/ de'ang nam 'chi'i cha ma mchis shi tshe chos ma gtogs gang gis kyang mi phan snyam zhing skabs tsa na rang nad kyis btab ste shi phung po dur khrod du bskyal te keng rus su gyur rnam shes bya spu rlung khyer ltar dbang med du 'phyo ba la sems gtad de/ skyo shas dang long med kyi blo sna thung sbud pa bya'o/ /chos thun dang dmigs thun gsum pa'o// gsum pa las rgyu 'bras bsam pa ni/ de nas las rgyu 'bras bsam par bya dgos pas/ spyir bde sdug thams cad las la brten nas byung ba yin te/ las brgya pa las/ las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs las/ /de yis 'gro rnams sna tshogs byas/

/zhes dang*/ snying rje pad dkar las/ 'jig rten ni las kyis byas pa las kyis sprul pa'o/ /sems can rnams ni las kyis byas pa las kyi rgyu las byung ba/ las kyis rab tu phye ba'o/ /zhes dang*/ mdzod las/ las las 'jig rten sna tshogs skyes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ las de'ang sems pa'i las dang bsam pa'i las gnyis su 'du zhing de'ang lus ngag yid kyi las gsum du 'dus te/ de ni sems pa dang des byas/ /sems pa yid kyi las yin te/ /des bskyed lus dang ngag gi las/ /zhes gsungs so// de 'ang tshe 'dir bde sdug ci snang ba de skye ba snga ma rnams su dge mi dge gang spyad kyi 'bras bu yin zhing*/ 'dir las gang dang gang spyad pa de'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu skye ba phyi ma de'ang mi dge ba spyad pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bus ngan song gsum du skye/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu ni/ gsod pa yis ni tshe thung 'gyur/ /ma phar 'tshe bas gnod pa mang*// brkus pa yis ni longs spyod phongs/ /byi bo byed pas dgra zlar bcas// rdzun du smra bas skur pa ste/ /phra ma yis ni bshes dang 'byed// tshig rtsub nyid kyis mi snyan thos/ /ma 'brel bas ni tshig mi btsun// brnab sems yid la re ba 'joms/ /gnod sems 'jigs pa sbyin par byed// log par lta ba lta ngan nyid/ /ces dang*/ dbang 'bras ni/ phyi rol gzi chung gnod pa mang*/ /rdul 'khrigs dri nga mtho dman can// tshwa sgo can dang log pa dang*/ /'bras bu phra kha chung ngam med// ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /las mi dge bcu spyad pa'i 'bras bu de dag yin cing*/ dge ba bcu spyad na bde 'gro'i lus bde ba dang ldan pa thob cing yul yid du 'ong bar skye bar 'gyur ro// de'ang mi dge ba che 'bring chung gsum du spyad pa dang zhe sdang 'dod chags gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te las bsags pa las dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams su skye zhing*/ dge ba chung ngu spyad pas mi lus/

'bring 'dod lha sogs/ che ba spyad pas bsam gtan dang gzugs med rnams su skye ste/ de skad du'ang rin chen phreng bar/ chags dang zhe sdang gti mug dang*/ /des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// mi dge las ni sdug bsngal dang*/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med/ /des bskyed las ni dge ba yin// dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang*/ /skye ba kun tu bde ba dag /ces dang*/ chags pas yi dwags 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhe sdang gis ni dmyal bar 'phen// rmongs pas dud 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ dran nye chung ba las/ dge ba yis ni bde ba 'thob/ /mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// de ltar dge dang mi dge ba'i/ /las dang 'bras bu gsal bar bstan// zhes dang*/ rin chen phreng bar/ bsam gtan tshad med gzugs med kyis// tshangs sogs bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so// lus kyi mi dge ba gsum/ ngag gi bzhi/ yid kyi gsum sogs mi dge ba thams cad spang zhing de las ldog pa'i dge bcu bsgrub pa la 'bad par bya dgos te/ las brgya pa las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za// tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur// zhes dge mi dge gang byas de sems la sa bon du bzhag ste de sad byed kyi rkyen zhig dang nam phrad pa na rnam smin bde sdug so sor bslu med du 'byung*/ kun slong nyon mongs kyis bslang ba zhig yin na tshul khrims bsrung ba thos bsam sgom pa sogs ltar snang gi dge ba ci byas kyang thams cad chos ltar bcos pa yin pas chos rnal mar mi 'gro'o// de'ang rang gis byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu ni rang thog kho nar myong ba ma gtogs gzhan dang thun mong du bgo byar med/ gnyen po bskyed de sa bon bcom na ma gtogs bskal pa mtha' yas pa'i bar du'ang bag la nyal chud mi za bar gnas/ so so'i 'bras bu'ang bslu med du 'byung ste/

mdo las/ lhas byin nyid kyis byas pa'i las ni sa dang chu la sogs pa la mi smin gyi de nyid kyi zin pa'i phung po dang skye mched 'ba' zhig la smin par 'gyur te/ gzhan su zhig la smin par 'gyur/ zhes dang*/ chos mngon pa kun las btus las/ ji ltar las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa yin zhe na/ rang gis byas pa'i rnam par smin pa myong ba ste/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las so so la spyod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang*/ des pas zhus pa las/ sa bon tsha ba rnams la ni/ /'bras bu tsha ba skye bar 'gyur// sa bon mngar ba rnams la ni/ /'bras bu mngar ba skye bar 'gyur// dpe zlar bya ba 'di yis ni/ /sdig pa'i rnam smin tsha ba dang*// dkar po'i rnam smin mngar ba yang*/ /mkhas pa yis ni shes par bya// zhes dang*/ dran nye chung bar/ me ni grang bar 'gyur yang srid/ /rlung ni zhags pas zin kyang srid// nyi zla thang la lhung yang srid/ /las kyi rnam smin bslu mi srid// ces gsungs so/ /thun dmigs bzhi pa'o// ༈ spyir las de la/ mthong chos myong 'gyur/ skye gnas myong 'gyur/ lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur/ myong bar ma nges pa dang bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ zhing bsam gyi khyad par las/ las de'i 'bras bu tshe de la smin pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ mtshams med lnga dang nye ba'i mtshams med lnga la byed/ de'ang skye ba phyi ma sogs la 'bras bu 'byung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ las brgya pa las/ lus can dag gi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi las lta bu la byed/

yang na bsod nams kyi las/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i las/ mi g.yo ba'i las dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dod khams kyi dge ba'i las la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ mi dge ba'i las la byed/ gsum pa ni/ khams gong ma gnyis kyi dge ba'i las la byed/ yang na gcig tu dkar ba'i las/ gcig tu gnag pa'i las/ 'dres ma'i las/ rnam smin zad byed kyi las dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ khams gong ma'i dge las la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i mi dge ba la byed/ gsum pa ni 'dod pa'i dge las la byed/ bzhi pa ni/ zag med kyi las la byed de/ des rnam smin yid du 'ong mi 'ong spel ma sogs 'byin cing zag med kyi las kyis las snga ma de dag zad par byed pa'i phyir/ yang na bsam pa dkar la sbyor ba gnag pa sogs bzhir yod/ dang po ni/ ded dpon snying rje chen pos tshong pa g.yo can bsad pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni srog gcod kyi phyir sbyin pa gtong ba lta bu/ gsum pa ni bsam pa dag pas sbyin pa gtong ba lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ sha za phyir srog gcod pa lta bu'o// yang na bde sdug btang snyoms myong 'gyur gyi las gsum du yod/ dang po ni/ 'dod pa nas bsam gtan gsum pa'i bar gyi dge las la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i dge las la byed/ gsum pa ni bsam gtan bzhi pa yan chad kyi dge las la byed/ yang na 'phen rdzogs gnyis la mu bzhir yod/ dang po gnyis ka dge ba ni bde 'gro'i rten can gyi bde ba lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ ngan 'gro'i rten can gyi sdug bsngal la byed/ gsum pa 'phen byed dge la rdzogs byed sdig pa ni bde 'gro'i rten can gyi sdug bsngal la byed/ bzhi pa ni ngan 'gro'i rten can gyi bde ba lta bu la byed/ yang na dge ba'i las/ mi dge ba'i las/ lung ma bstan pa'i las dang gsum las/ dang po la/ zag bcas dang zag med kyi dge las gnyis las/ dang po ni srog gcod spong ba la sogs pa dge ba'i las lam bcu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/

thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa mi dge ba'i las ni mi dge ba'i las lam bcu la byed/ gsum pa la/ bsgribs lung ma bstan dang*/ ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khams gong gi nyon mongs can gyi las lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni/ bzo byed pa'i las lta bu la byed/ bsgribs ma bsgribs kyi khyad par lung ma bstan gzhir byas la nyon mongs can yin min la byed/ ma bsgribs lung ma bstan la dbye na/ rnam smin skyes/ spyod lam pa/ bzo gnas/ sprul sems dang bzhir yod/ yang las la dbye na/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po ni snod kyi 'jig rten 'grub byed kyi las lta bu la byed/ gnyis pa ni bcud kyi sems can 'grub byed kyi las lta bu la byed/ 'di dag gi don rgyas pa dang gzhung gi tshig gsal ba rnams mngon pa mdzod kyi las bstan pa dang mdo sde las brgya pa dang rin chen phreng ba sogs nas rgyas par 'byung ba ltar nyams su len par bya dgos/ des na dge sdig gi blang dor ma 'chol bar bya zhing sgo gsum lung ma bstan du'ang ma lus par dge sbyor la nan tan bya zhing dus rtag tu rang gi sgo gsum la brtag dpyad bya/ dge bar gyur pa rnams la dga' ba sgom chud mi 'dza' bar byed/ sdig par gyur pa rnams la stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags bsdam tshul bzhin bya/ me stag chung ngus nags tshal sreg nus pa ltar dge bas sdig pa'i phung po 'joms par nus pa la spro bas 'jug par bya dgos te/ tshoms las/ bsod nams chung ngu byas pas kyang*/ /'jig rten pha rol bde chen 'dren// don chen dag kyang byed 'gyur te/ /'bru rnams phun tshogs smin pa bzhin// zhes gsungs pas so/ /de ltar sdig pa phra zhing phra ba nas spang*/ dge ba phra zhing phra ba nas bsgrub/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la nan tan du byas na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i don kyang 'grub ste/

sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes 'byung ngo*// mdor bsdus nas bsgom bya ni/ shi nas gar skye rang dbang 'dus pa zhig yin na dang de kas chog ste gar skye rang gis byas pa'i las la rag las pas las rgyu 'bras kyi blang dor tshul bzhin ma 'chol bar nyams su len snyam pa byas te rang rgyud la gzhig 'grel byed cing sdig pa spang dge ba bsgrub par brtson pa bskyed do/ /thun dmigs lnga pa'o// bzhi pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa ni/ de nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom dgos te/ thog med nas nga med par nga dang bdag med par bdag tu zhen pa'i ma rig pa'i rgyu la brten nas 'khor ba'i 'khrul pa 'byung zhing sdug bsngal gsum gyis bar ma chad du mnar ro// de'ang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal tshor ba btang snyoms dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni tshor ba bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba mngon gyur pa rnams so/ /dpe ni rim bzhin me mdag bsnyal ba lta bu dang*/ de'i steng du rtswa bkab pa'i khar skye bo gnyid log pa lta bu dang*/ de rlung gis bus pas 'bar te skyes bu nyam nyes pa lta bu'o// de yang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni/ srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar la khyab cing*/ gzugs dang 'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams kyang las kyi 'phen shugs zad nas ltung ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba nyer len gyi phung po 'di blangs tsam nas sdug bsngal dang ldan pa yin la/ de so skyes mi shes shing 'phags pa rnams kyis tshul bzhin gzigs te/ dper na spu nyag gcig lag mthil du bzhag kyang ma bde ba med la/ de nyid mig tu song na mi bde ba bzhin no/ /de yang mdzod 'grel las/ lag mthil spu nyag gcig 'dug pa/ /de ni mig tu song ba na// mi bde ba dang sdug bsngal skyed/

/byis pa lag mthil 'dra ba yis// 'du byed sdug bsngal spu mi rtogs/ /'phags pa mig dang 'dra ba yis// 'du byed la ni sdug bsngal gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya sogs 'dod yon gyi ro la chags sred kyis spyod pa ste/ 'di dag ni bdud kyi mda' dang pho nya mo dang spu gri'i sor chags kyi sbrang rtsi dang tshwa chu dang g.yen pa 'phrug pa ltar longs spyod pa'i mthar sdug bsngal mi bzad pa 'byung zhing de'ang 'khor ba'i bde ba thams cad mthar thug 'gyur nas sdug bsngal du 'gro bas sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ 'jig rten na che bar grags pa 'khor los sgyur rgyal dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa sogs kyi go 'phang thob kyang mthar thug sdug bsngal du 'gyur te/ bshes spring las/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid du gyur nas kyang*// 'khor ba dag tu yang bran nyid du 'gyur// brgya byin mchod 'os nyid du gyur nas kyang*// las kyi dbang gis slar yang sa steng lhung*// tshangs nyid chags bral bde ba thob nas slar// mnar med me yi bud shing gyur pa yi// sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad pa bsten 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so// de la sdug bsngal du ma mthong bde bar zhen pa la brten nas 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la chags sdang blos mi thongs shing dam pa'i chos kyi skal ba dang bral bar gyur to/ /des na zas gos kyi rkyen dang gtam mi snyan pa tshig gcig tsam mi theg pa 'di lta bu ma yin par 'khor ba'i bshal thag ci chod gal che'o// sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ni 'gro ba rigs drug so so'i steng du mang zhing*/ sdig shas che ba dmyal bar skyes nas sdug bsngal myong tshul ni gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shur gzhal ba na lcags bsregs rab tu 'bar ba'i sa gzhir sdig pas bsgrubs pa'i sha'u mar gsar lta bu dpag tshad mang po yod pa'i steng du sdug bsngal thog tu bab cing de'ang yang sos/

thig nag /bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med pa ste tsha dmyal brgyad/ nye 'khor ba/ me ma mur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ spu gri'i tshal/ ral gri'i lo ma'i nags/ shal ma li'i sdong po/ thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med phyogs bzhir re re rnams gnas te/ mdzod las/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na/ /mnar med pa 'o de tsam mo// de yi steng na dmyal ba bdun/ /brgyad po kun la lhag bcu drug/ de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na/ /me ma mur dang ro myags dang*// spu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin/ /chu bur can sogs grang brgyad gzhan// zhes so/ /grang dmyal brgyad ni/ gling 'di'i 'og rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram na mun nag gi smag rum rlung bu yug 'tshubs pa'i 'khyags sbubs na/ chu bur can/ chu bur rdol pa can/ a chu zer ba/ kyi hud zer ba/ so tham pa/ ut+pal ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar cher gas pa ste brgyad do/ /nyi tshe ba rnams gnas la nges pa med cing sdug bsngal yang sna tshogs myong bas dmyal ba de rnams na bde ba'i go skabs skad cig kyang med par sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la spyod cing gnas la/ sdug bsngal ni mi'i yul 'dir skyes bu'i lus la mtshon sum brgya dal med du bsnun pa des ni dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyi zur tsam du+u 'ang mi phyin no/ /tsha dmyal ba rnams kyi tshe tshad ni mi lo lnga bcu la rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i nyin zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub/ yang sos pas rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i tshe tshad la nyin zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pas mi lo stong drug brgya la nyin zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo khri drug stong thub/ dmyal ba tsha bas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i tshe tshad la nyin zhag gcig tu byas pa'i rang lo khri drug stong thub/ rab tu tsha bas bar bskal phyed/ mnar med pas bar bskal gcig gi bar du sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba myong ba yin/

grang dmyal chu bur can gyis til khal brgyad cu 'gro ba'i bang ba til gyis byur bur bkang ste lo brgya brgya na til re phyir phyung bas til de zad pa na tshe tshad rdzogs pa yin cing*/ gzhan rnams ni de las nyi shu 'gyur yin no// 'di rnams mngon pa nas gsal bar don bsdus te bshad pa ni/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ /'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam// des na de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin// rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni/ /bar gyi bskal pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ til rdzang nang nas lo brgya bzhin/ /til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa// chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so// yi dwags kyi gnas ni/ 'di 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya 'jal ba na gshin rje'i 'jig rten yod la 'phros pa ni mi yul dang nam mkhas khyab par yod/ sdug bsngal gyi khyad par ni/ phyi'i sgrib pa can mthong tshad mtshon char mthong rnag khrag tu mthong bas bzar med/ nang gi sgrib pa can zas skom mgrin par mi thar ba sogs/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can ni gang zos mer 'bar ba la sogs sdug bsngal dpag tu med tshe tshad mi'i zla ba gcig la zhag gcig tu brtsis pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub ste/ yi dwags rnams/ zla ba nyin zhag gis lnga brgya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dud 'gro'i gnas la nges pa med cing che ba ri rab tsam chung ba skra rtse tsam 'byung zhing sdug bsngal gcig gis gcig za ba bkol gsod gcod rmo 'gel dbyug gus bsnun pa sogs dang klu rnams la bye tshan gyi char bab nas sha rus 'bral bar byed/ tshe tshad skad cig ma dang klu 'ga' zhig bskal par yang gnas pas ma nges te/ dud 'gro rnams/ mchog ring bskal pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thun dmigs drug pa'o// ༈ bde 'gro yang rang cag mi'i steng du sdug bsngal 'byung ba'ang skye rga na 'chi bzhi/ sdug pa dang bral ba/ mi sdug pa dang phrad pa/

dgra sdang ba dang phrad pa/ gnyen byams pa dang bral ba/ yod pa srung dka' zhing med pa btsal kyang mi rnyed pa sogs sngar yang myong zhing da dung yang rgyun mi 'chad du myong*/ lha ma yin ni 'thab rtsod kyis gsod gcod 'bigs pa sogs kyis sdug bsngal/ 'dod lha rnams kyang re zhig 'dod yon la chags shing myos nas ma tshor bar tshe tshad zad de/ me tog gi rgyan rnying stan la mi dga' lha'i bu dang bu mos spangs/ lus la dri ngan bro gnas 'og mar ltung bar shes pas 'jigs shing nyam nga bag tsha/ skyug bro ste ci bya gtol dang bral ba sogs kyi 'chi ltas lnga rnams 'byung bas sems kyi sdug bsngal dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal 'bum 'gyur las kyang che/ bsam gtan bzhi gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi rnams kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ma spangs pas nyon sgrib bag nyal dang bcas thar pa 'dod pa'i bsam pa med par ting nge 'dzin gyis myos te/ re zhig sdug bsngal med kyang skye 'chi la rang dbang ma thob pas sngar gyi dge 'bras rnams rdzogs pa dang gnas de btang ste ngan song sogs su skye bas slar yang sdug bsngal myong ngo*/ /des na ji skad du/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thungs pas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dang*/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdor/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mthong ba na// skyo ba'i sems ni rab tu bskyed// khams gsum btson rar 'jigs pas na// rtson pa'i sems kyis spong bar byed// ces dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'khor ba de 'dra lags pas lha mi dang*// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams dag tu// skye ba bzang po ma lags skye ba ni// gnod pa du ma'i snod gyur lags mkhyen mdzod// ces gsungs so/ /des na 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs khyim gyi sdug bsngal 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng tshe 'di'i bya ba la dgos med kyi blo bskyed de de dang de 'dra ba la thar 'dod kyi blos nags mtha' mes tshig pa'i ri dwags bzhin bred sha dang bcas rings par 'bros/

mtsho 'khyags pa'i bya bzhin gdung ba bcad de 'bros/ ded dpon srin mo'i gling nas thar ba ltar zhen chags bcad de ya nga bas 'bros/ chu bo sgrol bar rkyal pa'i gces spras bzhin sdom gsum la nyes pas ma gos par 'khor ba'i pha rol du 'bros/ lam du chas pa'i tshong pa'i grabs shoms bzhin tshogs gnyis dang dge ba'i nor tshags su tshud pas spro ba dang bcas 'khor ba las 'bros dgos/ de ltar ma byas na ri dwags mes tshig chu bya 'khyags par 'byar ded dpon srin mos zos rkyal mkhan chur shi tshong pa stong par log pa ltar 'khor ba'i mes tshig khyim gyi 'khyags sbubs su tshud tshe 'di'i srin mos zos ngan song gi chur lhung dal 'byor stong par log pa yin pas/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba blos btang 'dod yon la chags pa spangs chos brgyad rgyang du bsrings 'chi ba snying la gzer 'khor ba sdug bsngal du mthong srid pa zhi ba nyan rang gi go 'phang yang ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don du mi 'gyur bas ma rgan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang zhig ci nas kyang bsgrub par bya snyam pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa bskyed/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan na bla med kyi byang chub kyang ring por mi thogs par mngon du byed nus so snyam du phan yon yongs su dran pa'i sgo nas nam yang yongs su mi nyams par bsrung zhing brtson pa dang ldan par bya'o//

༈ de ni cung zad rgyas par byas pa yin la/ mdor bsdus nas bsgom bya ni/ 'khor ba 'di na srid rtse nas mnar med yan sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas 'khor ba'i gnas grogs longs spyod snyan grags thams cad gsod sar khrid pa'i gshed ma'i dga' ston ltar mthong nas 'khor ba 'di me 'obs sam btson dong lta bur bltas te dgos med kyi blo bskyed la 'khor ba'i shal thag ci chod dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bdag gis ci nas kyang bsgrub snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po bya dgos so/ /'di rnams ni thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor zhes bya'o/ /thun dmigs bdun pa'o/ /rgyas par thun bzhi bsdoms na bzhi pa'o// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor ni/ rgyud snod du rung ba'am ci byas thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid do/ /dang po ni/ 'o na 'jig rten gyi drag rtsal can tshangs pa khyab 'jug sogs sam pha ma gnyen nye bar bcas pa rnams skyabs yul yin nam zhe na/ skyabs thub pa ni rang 'jigs pa las thar zhing sdug bsngal dang bral ba zhig dgos pa las de dag de ltar ma yin pas skyabs min no/ /des na gnas skabs kyi skyabs dkon mchog gsum yin zhing mthar thug ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig gtan gyi skyabs su 'gyur zhing de la gsum ga tshang ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ /zhes dang*/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /dam chos 'dra ba'i skyob pa med// dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing mchog med/ /ces dang*/

mdo sde myang 'das las/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song ba/ /'jigs pa med pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /skyabs su 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa la sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral zhing gtan gyi skyabs thub pa sangs rgyas las med/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam chos las med/ chos byed pa'i grogs dge 'dun las med pas dkon mchog gsum la ma brten par byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs med cing nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khongs su mi gtogs dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la gegs dang bar chad 'byung ba sogs kyi skyon yon du ma dang bcas pas na skyabs su 'gro ba gal che'o// phan yon dang byed las ni/ sangs rgyas sar tshud/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten byed/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa zad/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi gnod pa las skyob/ bsam pa'i dngos po thams cad 'grub cing bsod nams chen po 'thob/ ngan song du mi ltung zhing myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /'tshe ba sogs las kyang skyob ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ 'tshe ba dag ni thams cad dang*/ /ngan song dang ni thabs min dang*// 'jigs tshogs theg pa dman pa las/ /skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam par 'dod// ces gsungs so/ /des na spyi'i bslab bya dang bye brag gi bslab bya dang cha mthun gyi bslab bya rnams la slob cing spang bya rnams spangs te blang dor ma 'chol bar bya dgos so/ /de ltar phan yon dang nyes dmigs du ma rig pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro dgos shing*/ de la'ang skyabs yul gsal btab ste skyabs su 'gro bar bya ba ni/ mdun du dpag bsam shing gi sdong po rtsa ba gcig pa rtse mo dang yal ga lo 'dab nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa yal ga lnga phyogs bzhir 'bur du dod pa/ de'i dbus kyi ze'u 'bru'i steng du seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan steng du rang gi tshe phyi ma phan gyi re ltos zhu sa tshe 'di la dbang dang gdams ngag thob pa'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid bla ma de ka'i rnam pa can nam yang na khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po in+d+ra rnyil sbyangs pa lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku bkrag mdangs dang zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing thugs dgyes pa dang bcas pa gzi brjid 'bar ba zhig tu sgom/

de'i dbu gtsug nas yar la bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams mtho brtsegs dang sgrub rgyud kyi bla ma rnams sprin ltar gtibs pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad na bun ltar bar mtshams med par bzhugs pa gdan mtshams su chos skyong srung ma rnams bdag nyid kyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad sel phyir zhal phyir phyogs shing khro gtum dang ldan par sgom/ de'i mdun gyi 'dab mar gdan khri sngar bzhin la pad+ma nyi ro'i gdan steng du yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'am/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa/ ma rgyud ma hā mā yā/ snying po dgyes pa'i rdo rje/ gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs gang mos bskyed cing de la rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par sgom/ g.yas kyi 'dab ma'i steng du gdan khri rnams ro gdan ma gtogs thams cad la rigs 'gre ba'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis sogs phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs par sgom/ rgyab tu theg pa chen po'i chos dkon mchog rnams po ti'am glegs bam gyi tshul du rdza ri nyil ba ltar gser gdong khra chem me rang la bstan te bzhugs par sgom/ g.yon gyi yal ga'i steng du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang mchog zung kun dga' bo 'od srungs sogs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams na bza' ngur smrig dbu zlum zhabs rjen gyi tshul du bzhugs par bsam/ de'i bar mtshams su yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams na bun dang bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar bzhugs par sgom/ shing gi mtha' skor du ne'u gsing yod pa'i steng du bdag la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra gnod par byed pa'i bgegs su gyur pa rnams dang rang gi gnyen du gyur pa sogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad khrom tshogs su them 'gags nem 'gags su gnas pa rnams kyis kyang rang dang spyod lam sgo bstun te skyabs 'gro'i sgra 'ur di ri ri 'don par bsams la/

ngag tu bdag gi drin can pha mas gtso byas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /sogs don yid la dran zhing tshig rgyun mar 'don bsgom bya zhing skyabs yul rnams la shes pa gtad la sems ma yengs par rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go/ de nas sems bskyed pa ni/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ mthar skyabs yul gdan khri dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang skyabs yul rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur snyam pa'i ngang nas sems ma bcos par rang lugs su glod/ gsal sing nge ba la ngos gzung med pa gar yang mi 'phro ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go/ gal te rnam rtog 'phro na/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag/ phyag rgya chen po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog/ ces dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bas rgyas btab la spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o/ /chos thun dang dmigs pa brgyad pa'o// ༈ de'ang spyir sems bskyed la theg dman sems bskyed dang theg chen sems bskyed gnyis su yod pa las/

dang po ni/ rang nyid zhi bde 'dod pa'i phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin pa lam chod chung ste/ nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal dag /byang chub thob pa'i gtan gyi gegs/ /zhes dang*/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du ltung*/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nyan rang gi byang chub tsam ma gtogs mthar thug gi byang chub thob mi nus pas/ 'dir ni theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la 'bad dgos shing theg chen gyi sems bskyed de la yang*/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba/ mtshan nyid/ rgyu rkyen/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams sogs du ma yod pa las/ dang po ni/ theg chen kun rdzob sems bskyed dang don dam sems bskyed gnyis la byed de/ dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ byang chub kyi sems de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mtshan nyid ni gzhan don du rdzogs byang la dmigs pa'i mkhyen pa theg chen kun rdzob sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /rgyu rkyen ni mang du gsungs kyang mdor bsdu na/ rgyal ba sras bcas la dad pa/ sems can la snying brtse ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa rnams yin te/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /rtag tu sems can phan par sems/ /zhes dang*/ dkon mchog ta la'i mdor/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*// rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed pa// byang chub bla na med la dad gyur na// skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye 'o// zhes dang*/ mdo sdud par/ sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes// yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal ba de skad gsung*// zhes gsungs so/ /dbye ba la/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed nas sprin lta bu'i sems bskyed kyi bar nyer gnyis su yod de/

rgyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ zhes pa nas/ rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang na mos pas spyod pa/ lhag bsam rnam dag dang*/ rnam par smin pa'i dang*/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhir yod de/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*// rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o// zhes gsungs so/ /de dag gi sa mtshams ni/ sa sogs kyi sems bskyed rnams las dang po gsum ni las dang po pa'i sas bsdus/ de'i 'og tu gcig ni sbyor lam gyis bsdus/ de nas bcu ni sa bcus bsdus/ de 'og lnga ni sa bcu'i khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus/ phyi ma gsum sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus so/ /phyi ma'i mos ldan sogs bzhi ni/ las dang po pa dang*/ ma dag sa bdun dang*/ dag pa sa gsum dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus so/ /yang sems bskyed de la/ rgyal po lta bu/ rdzi bo lta bu/ mnyen pa lta bu dang gsum mo/ /yang smon 'jug gnyis su yod de/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste// byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no// zhes gsungs so/ /de gnyis kyi khyad par rdzogs byang du 'gro 'dod pa dang 'gro bzhin pa lta bu yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar// de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya// zhes gsungs so/ /yang na smon pa ni 'bras bu la dmigs nas dam 'cha'/ 'jug pa ni rgyu la dmigs nas dam 'cha' ba'o/ /dmigs yul ni/ byang chub dang sems can gyi don la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ theg chen gyi ye shes tshol bar dmigs pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ de bzhin de yi ye shes tshol bar dmigs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sems can la dmigs pa ni nam mkhas khyab tshad kyi sems can la dmigs pa ste de rnams kyi sdug bsngal sel phyir sems bskyed pa ste/

bzang spyod las/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa ji tsam par// sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te// ji tsam las dang nyon mongs mthar gyur pa// bdag gi smon lam mtha' yang de tsam mo// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang kun rdzob sems bskyed ni rags pa brda las byung zhing skye la/ don dam sems bskyed ni don dam chos nyid kyi stobs kyis skye'o/ / dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ / thos stobs dge ba goms pa las// mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba/ / gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad// ces gsungs so/ /don dam sems bskyed skye ba'i rgyu ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces lung dang mthun pa'i sgrub pa dang rtogs pa'i khyad par dag gis bskyed pa'o/ /don dam sems bskyed kyi ngo bo ni/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gsal la mi g.yo ba spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de'o/ /de'ang dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ de la don dam byang chub kyi sems de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba shin tu gsal ba don dam pa'i yul can dri ma med pa mi g.yo ba rlung med pa'i mar me'i rgyun ltar shin tu gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs so// sa mtshams ni/ sa dang po nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod de/ mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel par/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa de yang sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la sogs yin pas zhes so/ /de'ang kun rdzob sems bskyed blang yul ni/ lam sgron las/ yang dag mtshan nyid ldan pa yi/ /bla ma bzang la sdom pa blang*// sdom pa'i cho ga la mkhas dang*/ /bdag nyid gang zhig sdom la gnas// sdom pa 'bogs bzod snying rjer ldan/ /bla ma bzang por shes par bya// zhes pa ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma las blang zhing de ltar ma thub na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar sems bskyed gang len pa'i tshig rnams snying thag pa nas lan gsum brjod pas smon 'jug gi sdom pa'ang 'thob ste/

byang sa las/ gal te yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i gang zag med par gyur na byang chub sems dpas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar bdag nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar bya ste/ zhes gsungs so//

de'ang med na mdun du dmigs nas blangs kyang skye ste/ bslab btus las/ yang de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon sum du bsgoms nas/ sdom pa bdag nyid kyi stobs dang sbyar nas blangs te/ zhes gsungs so// blang ba'i cho ga ni/ mang yang 'dir 'phags pa 'jam dpal nas slob dpon klu sgrub la brgyud pa slob dpon zhi ba lha'i lugs ltar na sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ smon 'jug gi sems bskyed kyi rgyu'i gtso bo ni bsod nams kyi tshogs la brten dgos shing de'ang yul dkon mchog gsum gyi mthus 'byung bas/ dkon mchog gsum dang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi drung du mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams shing yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar zhing bsdu na/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ dngos gzhi ni/ skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed kyi sdom pa len dgos pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can chos gos rnam gsum dang ldan zhing mtshan dpes spras pa zhabs skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa nye ba'i sras brgyad sogs byang sems kyi dge 'dun dang nyan rang gi dge 'dun sogs nam mkha'i khams gang ba bzhugs par mos la sangs rgyas la ston pa chos la lam dge 'dun la lam sgrub pa'i grogs su bzung nas sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis smon pa dang 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/

bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma sha stag yin pas de'i ched du byang chub tu sems bskyed snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos mdzod/ ces brda sbyar/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ zhes pa nas/ rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar tshar gsum gyis smon 'jug bsdoms nas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'o/ /rjes kyi cho ga la bdag dga' ba sgom pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes dang*// gzhan dga' ba sgom pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis/ bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes tshar re brjod/ bslab bya la skyabs 'gro'i dang*/ sems bskyed kyi bslab bya gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mya ngan las 'das mdor/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te// nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la/ /phyag ni bya ba ma yin no// dam pa'i chos la skyabs song ba/ /'tshe zhing gsod pa'i sems dang bral// dge 'dun la ni skyabs song ba/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs mi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi slob pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar rgyas par phye na mang du yod cing*/ mdor bsdu na/ theg chen gyi bla ma la gus pa/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang ba/ dkar po'i chos bzhi bsten pa/ sems can blos mi spong ba/ smon pa'i bslab bya bsdus pa sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa/ don med pa'i sdig pa mi byed de/

ci nus kyi dge ba sgrub pa ni 'jug pa'i bslab bya'o/ /rgyas par na thar rgyan las gsungs pa ltar smon pa'i bslab bya sdoms su mdzad pa ni/ sems can blos mi btang ba dang*/ /sems de'i phan yon dran bya dang*// tshogs gnyis bsag par bya ba dang*/ /yang yang byang sems sbyang ba dang*// dkar nag chos brgyad blang dor te/ /lnga pos smon pa'i bslab bya bsdus// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'jug pa'i bslab bya ni gtso bor bslab pa gsum yin cing de yang phar phyin drug tu 'dus pas de'i dbang du byas nas sdoms su mdzad pa ni/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*// brtson 'grus bsam gtan shes rab ste// de ltar rnam pa drug po yis// 'jug pa'i sems bskyed bslab bya bsdus// zhes gsungs pas/ spang blang 'jug ldog ma nor bar dam pa'i chos la spyod par byos shig /de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i phan yon ni/ dpal byin gyis zhus pa'i mdor/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te 'di la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste// de ni de bas ches lhag 'gyur// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur nas skad cig gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams// bder gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya ste// 'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ /deng nas bzung ste gnyid log gam// bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa du ma zhig/ nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung*/ /zhes gsungs so// byang sems btang na nyes dmigs ni/ ngan 'gror 'gro ba dang*/ gzhan don nyams pa dang*/ sa thob pa'i gegs byed cing yun ring 'gor ba'o/ /de skad du/ gal te de ltar dam bcas nas/ /las kyis sgrub par ma byas na// sems can de dag kun bslus pas/ /bdag gi 'gro ba ji ltar 'gyur// zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs pas phan yon dang nyes dmigs tshul bzhin du shes te blang dor ma 'chol bar nan tan snying por byas na ring por mi thogs par mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bas de ltar yid la byos shig

/ces brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ /chos thun dgu pa'o// gnyis pa sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ spyir dge sdig thams cad yid kyi kun slong la rag las te/ rin chen phreng bar/ chos rnams yid ni sngon 'gro bas/ /yid ni gtso bo zhes grags pas// zhes dang*/ mdzod las/ sems pa yid kyi las yin te/ /des bskyed lus dang ngag gi las// zhes gsungs so/ /des na yid kyi chags sdang la sogs pa nyon mongs can gyis kun nas bslangs te mi dge ba bcu'am mtshams med pa lnga'am de dang nye ba lnga'am sdom pa dang dam tshig nyams pa la sogs pa rang gis byas sam gzhan byed du bcug gam byed pa la rjes su yi rang ba rnams dang*/ der ma zad chags sdang dang nyon mongs kyis kun nas bslangs te thos bsam bgyis pa rnams kyang sdig pa dang mi dge ba yin no/ /sgrib pa la nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis su yod cing dang pos thar pa la sgrib/ gnyis pas kun mkhyen la sgrib cing*/ dang po ni/ phra rgyas mngon pa 'og ma ltar dgu bcu rtsa brgyad/ gong ma ltar brgya dang nyer brgyad po rnams yin/ bsdu na 'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal ma rig pa the tshom lta ba ste rtsa nyon drug /khro sogs nye nyon nyi shu rnams la byed/ bsdu na chags sdang rmongs gsum du 'dus/ shes sgrib ni gzung rtog 'dzin rtog gnyis la byed/ de'ang shes byar srid tshad la mtshan mar bzung bar 'du zhing*/ bsdu na gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan 'dzin du 'dus/ de dag gi 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*/ /'di las ji ltar nges thar zhes// nyin mtshan kun du bdag gis ni/ /'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam par rigs// zhes gsungs so/ /des na sdig pa thams cad bshags na 'dag cing bshags tshul sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/

gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs dang*/ rten gyi stobs te stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags par bya'o/ /dang po la'ang don med pa dang*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ myur du 'bral dgos par brtags la 'gyod pa bskyed par bya'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa thams cad dgra 'dul gnyen skyong rgyu dngos sogs tshe 'di pa'i don du byas pa kho na red pas shi tshe de dag gang yang rjes su mi 'brang*/ las kho na grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang la/ de dag bsgrubs kyang dka' las che zhing ngal ba 'bras bu med pa yin snyam du bsam dgos te/ dpal byin gyis zhus pa'i mdor/ pha ma spun dang bu dang chung ma dang*// bran dang nor dang rtsa lag tshogs rnams kyang*// shi ba'i rjes phyir de dag 'gro ba med// las rnams rjes su 'brang zhing de dag 'gro/ zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ thams cad bor te cha dgos par/ /bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas// mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir/ /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ sdig pa'i 'bras bu 'chi kha gnad gcod dang shi 'og gshin rje'i pho nya dang shi nas dmyal ba sogs ngan song gsum du skye bas 'jigs pa chen por bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de la 'jigs te sdig pa 'phral du sbyang dgos te/ sdig pa ma byang bar glo bur du shi tshe thar med kyi dong du tshud nyen che ba'i phyir/ spyod 'jug las kyang*/ bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar/ /sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi// ji ltar 'di las nges thar bar/ /myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol// zhes dang*/ yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag 'dis/ /byas dang ma byas mi sdod par// na dang mi na kun gyis kyang*/ /glo bur tshe la yid mi brtan/ /zhes gsungs so// des na rgyu mtshan gsum gyis 'gyod pa bskyed la yul khyad par can gyi mdun du bshags par bgyi'o/ /'di ni dper na kha drag gi bu lon ma 'khor bar zhu ba byas pa dang 'dra'o/

/stobs gnyis pa ni/ sdig pa'i gnyen por dge ba spyod pa'o/ /de yang sdig pa mang po dge ba gcig tsam gyis kyang 'joms te/ myang 'das mdor/ dge ba gcig byas pas kyang sdig pa mang po 'joms te/ zhes dang*/ gser 'od las/ gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su/ /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad bgyis// lan gcig rab tu bshags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni mi gtsang bas gos pa khrus byas te dri bzang gis byugs pa dang 'dra'o/ /stobs gsum pa ni/ rnam smin gyis 'jigs nas phyin chad sdig pa'i 'phro gcod cing sdom pa yin te/ 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol/ /'di ni bzang po ma lags pas/ /slan chad bdag ni yong mi bgyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /'di ni chu 'od kha bsgyur ba dang 'dra'o/ /stobs bzhi pa ni/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yin te/ phag mo'i rtogs brjod las/ gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs song ba/ /de dag ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur// mi yi lus 'di spangs nas su/ /de dag lha yi lus thob bo// zhes gsungs shing*/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa shin tu mi zad bgyis na yang*// dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa che las ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten// zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni khas nyen pos dbang po che la 'jus pa'am dug la sngags btab pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na sngon mi dgu brgya dang go dgu bsad pa sor phreng can dang*/ ma bsad pa bde byed dang*/ bud med la chags pa gcung dga' bo dang*/ pha bsad pa mthong ldan sogs kyang stobs bzhi po re res sdig pa dag nas dgra bcom dang rgyun zhugs sogs thob pa yin te/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las// phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang*// zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te// dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin//

zhes gsungs so/ /chos thun bcu pa/ dmigs pa dgu pa'o// ༈ des na stobs bzhi'i nang nas gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs kyi mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la brten pa 'di nyid yin pas/ de'ang thog mar rang tha mal par gnas pa'i spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang a las zla ba'i gdan de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ngo bo rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la rnam pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar bstod pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu snyems pa'i tshul gyis dkur brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rigs bdag bla ma mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan dpung rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub ska rags do shal la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur gsal ba/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de'i mthar oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ zhes dang*/ de'i mthar oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya zhes pa nas/ satwa āḥ/ zhes pa rnams kha dog dkar po mu tig gi phreng ba lta bus g.yas skor du bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' la thim pas de nyid skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i skur bltas te/

ngag tu bla ma rdo rje sems dpas rang gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng zla ba dang bcas pa rnams las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang khral la babs pas sku lus thams cad dkar ltem gyis gang zhing lhag ma rnams zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong nas chang rdza'i them bu brtol ba ltar dang rgyang rgyang babs te rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rang gi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon dam tshig nyams chags mi mthun phyogs dang snyigs ma thams cad rnag khrag gam dud khu'am sol khu'i rnam par chu snas sbur ma khyer ba ltar ded cing 'og sgo gnyis dang dbang po'i sgo ba spu'i bu ga sor mo'i rtse mo rnams nas nag nu ru ru thon te dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thim zhing lus thams cad dkar sangs kyis dag pa'i nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis dkar ltem gyis gang ba'i lhag ma yar phyur rdo rje sems dpa'i zhabs la reg par bsams la yig brgya dang yi ge drug pa ci nus bzla/ mthar thal mo snying gar sbyar te/

mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig/ gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid thugs dgyes shing zhal 'dzum pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag yod do zhes dbugs dbyung ba'i gsung 'byon pa dang lhan cig tu 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer mi phyed par gyur snyam pa'i ngang nas mi dmigs par bzhag /rnam rtog 'phro na bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngos la spyod lam la 'jug go/ de ltar bsgoms pas sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags la/ lus yang zhing gnyid chung*/ khams bde zhing snying dga' yal ba 'byung*/ rmi lam du khrus byas pa/ gcer bur thon pa/ lus la rnag khrag 'dzag pa/ 'khru ba/ skyug pa/ gos dkar po gyon pa sogs rmi'o// gzhan yang zas ngan skyug pa/ zho dang 'o ma 'thung ba/ nyi zla mthong ba/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ me 'bar ba/ ma he dang mi nag po thub pa/ dge slong dang dge slong ma'i dge 'dun mthong ba/ 'o ma 'byung ba'i shing dang glang po che dang khyu mchog dang*/ ri dang seng ge'i khri dang khang bzang rnams kyi steng du 'dzeg pa/ chos nyan pa sogs rmis na sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags so/ /rtags byung nas kyang rgyang bskyur byas na mi 'ong bas 'phro mthud nas rtag tu bsgom zhing 'bad dgos so/ /chos thun bcu gcig pa/ dmigs pa bcu pa'o//

gsum pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid la/ spyir lhag bsam rnam dag gis kun nas bslangs te dge ba bsgrubs na tshogs gnyis kyi rgyur 'gyur zhing de'i nang nas kyang phar phyin drug la slob pa ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin la/ de 'ang dbu ma 'jug pa ltar na/ phar phyin dang po gsum bsod nams kyi tshogs dang phyi ma gsum ye shes kyi tshogs yin te/ sbyin sogs chos gsum 'di dag phal mo che// bde bar gshegs pas khyim pa rnams la bsngags// bsod nams zhes bya'i tshogs kyang de dag nyid/ /ces gsungs so// yang byams chos sogs ltar na/ dang po gnyis bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ shes rab kyi phar phyin ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ bzod brtson bsam gtan gsum tshogs gnyis ka'i char gtogs pa yin te/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi// tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi// gsum po gzhan ni gnyis char te/ /zhes gsungs so// yang na sbyin pa'i phar phyin bsod nams dang*/ phyi ma lnga char ye shes kyi tshogs yin te/ lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /khyad par 'di skabs bla ma mnyes par byas na tshogs rdzogs phul che zhing de'i rgyu mtshan yang sangs rgyas mnyes par byas na tshogs che bas bla ma las lhag pa'i sangs rgyas med pa'i phyir bla ma la mchod pa sogs lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas mnyes pa bsgrub par bya dgos te/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags// chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod/ /ces dang*/ rim lnga las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dpal 'byung gi rnam thar las/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams thams cad ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsrung ba'o/ /zhes dang*/ brgyad stong pa las/

'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas dang po nyid du dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid la bsnyen par bya bsten par bya bsnyen bkur bar bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhes gsungs so// yang ku+u sa li'i tshogs gsog bya na/ phaṭa ces pas rang gi snying dkar nag gi mtshams nas rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa rus pa'i rgyan skya khrol le ba zhig mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyangs kyis byon mdun du mi mgo'i sgyed po ri rab tsam gsum btsugs/ rang gi thod pa gri gug gis lings phaug de'i khar bzhag /thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dpral bar āḥs mtshan pa āḥ rang la bstan pa yangs shing rgya che bar bsam/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mas stod kyi cha'i phrag pa g.yas pa bregs thod pa'i nang du bcug gri gug gis dkrugs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ de rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gsol bas mnyes par gyur te mthar 'ja' yal ba ltar mi dmigs par bsam/ yang ro stod g.yon pa bcad thod par bcug /a mṛ ta sogs dang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa'i chos skyong srung ma thams cad sprin gtibs pa bzhin spyan drangs ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gsol bas mnyes te zag med kyi bde bas thugs rgyud gang bar bsams la mi dmigs par bsgom/

yang ro smad g.yas pa thod par bcug /a mṛ ta sogs dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drin can pha mas thog drangs 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no/ /khyed rnams gang la gang 'dod kyi zas gos kyis tshim nas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bar gyur cig /yang ro smad g.yon pa thod par bcug gong bzhin a mṛ ta dang sam+bha ra dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan nas brjod de/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha la me 'bar mas gtso byas yi dwags gaṅgā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma'i bye ma snyed kyi tshogs bkres skom dang dbul phongs kyis gdung pa mtha' dag la sbyin no/ /gang la gang 'dod kyi zas gos kyis tshim nas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang ste sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bsams la mi dmigs par bzhag / de rjes/ rgyal ba mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /dam can thugs dam skong gyur cig/ rigs drug 'dod pa tshim gyur cig /pha ma'i drin lan 'khor gyur cig/ 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam/ sogs dang dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo/ /de ni ku sa li'i tshogs gsog go /chos thun bcu gnyis pa/ dmigs pa bcu gcig pa'o// ༈ des na tshogs gsog gi rim pa mang yang maṇ+ḍal la brten nas tshogs gsog pa 'di khrid rim thams cad kyi sngon 'gror 'byung zhing mchog tu gyur pa yin pas de'i sgo nas tshogs gsog pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal de la sgrub pa'i dang*/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rin po che la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gnyis yod na che zhing bzang ba la sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dmigs rten bya zhing*/

cung zad dman pa la mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dmigs rten bya/ gcig las med na de nyid sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang*/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dmigs rten shing dang rdo la sogs pa la byed/ de yang ma 'byor na dmigs pa kho nas bya'o/ /de'ang lag len thub phyin gang che ba bsod nams che zhing*/ rin po che las grub na sor bzhi yan du longs pa/ sa rdo shing la sogs pa yin na mtho gang yan chad do/ /de las chung ba mi bsten/ dbyibs kun nas zlum po steng 'jam zhing mnyam pa dbus cung zad mtho ba 'bur du dod pa'i rnam pa can/ spyil mo dang tshom bu mi chags pa ma yin pa steng phyogs kyi drug cha dang mnyam pa'i ri zlum pos 'og tu 'khor ba mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ gas grum dang chag pa dang btsas khyer sogs ma yin par 'byor na dri bzang gis byugs shing ri mo med par bya'o// de'ang skyon de dag dbus la yod na bla ma/ mdun rang*/ g.yas pha ma dang nye 'brel/ g.yon mched grogs/ rgyab 'khor dang longs spyod la gnod/ tshom bu'ang rab rin po che/ 'bring dung dang 'gron bu/ tha ma'ang nas dang 'bras sogs 'bru bzang po la bya'o/ /dam tshig tu maṇ+ḍal stong par mi bzhag /legs par rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba'i dngos po thams cad sangs kyis dag par dmigs la maṇ+ḍal lag tu thogs te g.yas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas kri ya ba'i lugs la phyag g.yas pas g.yas skor du phyi zhing maṇ+ḍal bsrung ba bzhag nas tshom bu bkod pa yin/ nang pa'i lugs kyi g.yon skor du phyi zhing maṇ+ḍal gyi bsrung ba bzhag nas tshom bu bkod pa yin pas phyi lugs gnyis gang 'thad brtags la lan gsum sogs phyi/ de nas tshom bu dbus dang mtha' gang rung du nye drags pa ma yin pa yo ba dang 'thor ba dang che chung mi snyoms pa'i skyon sogs dang bral bar bkod de/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal dngos de nyid bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal de nyid rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa de'i nang gi dbus sogs su tshom bu lnga bkod de skyabs yul gyi skabs ltar dbus su gyad dang seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i khri dang pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/

phyogs bzhir mdun du yi dam sogs skyabs 'gro'i skabs ltar bskyed/ lha tshogs de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ/ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs te gnyis su med par bstim nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs su gsol la sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal de nyid mchod shoms kyi dbus sam mchod shoms med na stegs mdzes shing gtsang ba mchod pa'i rten gyi bzhugs gnas su 'os pa mtho la yangs pa'i sar bsham mo// gnyis pa mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ de'i mdun du cung zad dma' ba'i stan la rang nyid 'dug ste lag pa g.yon maṇ+ḍal dang g.yas su tshom bu thogs la yig brgya tshar gcig 'don pa dang sbrags nas gong bzhin maṇ+ḍal gyi rdul gtsang zhing dag par phyi ba dang sbrags gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsam/ tshig 'don pa dang don gsal 'debs pa dang tshom bu bkod pa rnams phyogs mthun bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥ hūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi/ zhes pa nas/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar dang*/ sa gzhi spos byugs ma dang*/ mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po dang*/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid yongs bzhes nas// bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ spro na phyogs bcu dus gsum ma dang*/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa thams cad bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs dang*/ thams cad mkhyen gzigs lha rnams dgongs su gsol/

/zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan yang spyi bshags dang yan lag bdun pa dang mchod bstod sogs gang shes kyi sgo nas bsag sbyang gi thabs la 'bad/ mthar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi lha tshogs rnams bdag nyid la gnyis su med par bstim ste dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo'o// tshogs rdzogs pa'i rtags su zas cher ma zos kyang mi ltogs/ shes rab phye bas sngar ma go ba'i chos mang du shes/ sngar brjed pa'i chos mang du dran zhing nyams dga' la blo bkol du btub pa 'byung*/ rmi lam du'ang bud med mang pos zas skom ster ba dang*/ nyi zla shar ba/ gyen la 'gro ba/ me tog gi thang la 'gro zhing me tog 'thu ba/ gos gsar gyon pa/ rgyan btags pa/ chu brgal bas pha rol du sgrol ba/ chu la gru'am zam pa btsugs pa/ maṇ+ḍal dang me long phyi zhing lta ba dung 'bud pa rnga po che brdung ba rol mo dkrol ba lha khang lta ba sogs rmi'o/ /de'ang thengs re tsam rmi pa la gtad ra med pas rtags 'di rnams yang yang dngos nyams rmi lam du byung na cung zad tshogs rdzogs pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin no/ /chos thun bcu gsum pa/ dmigs pa bcu gnyis pa'o// bzhi pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ de yang nyams rtogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin cing de la snod ldan gyi slob ma zhig gis mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma dam pa la rtse gcig tu kha zhe med par gsol ba btab cing bzlog med kyi mos gus phul na tshe gcig lus gcig la phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mngon du byed pa bslu ba med pa yin/ lhag par 'o skol gyi brgyud pa 'di byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa yin pas bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na nyams rtogs 'char mi srid la byin rlabs zhugs tshe dbang don gyi rtogs pa thams cad skad cig tu rgyud la skye'o/ /de ltar skye ba la 'ang dpon slob gnyis las kyi 'brel ba yod cing mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dgos/
