bdag gis stong nyid bsgoms pa las 'bras bu sa bcu lam lnga rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs pa thob par bya snyam pa stong nyid lam du shor ba zhes bya zhing de spang bar bya'o// des na rang gi sems rtogs na de nyid chos sku yin cing chos thams cad gdod ma nas sku bzhi ye shes lngar lhun gyis grub pas gsar du sangs rgyas mi 'tshol bar mnyam nyid chen po'i ngang du gnas par bya dgos so/ /stong nyid lam du ye shor stong nyid bsgoms pa dang gzod chos sku zhig thob par 'dod pa dang*/ 'phral shor gang shar gyis sgom gyi go mi chod par blos byas kyi ri mo bris te sgom pa gnyis 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du shes shing zhe 'dod kyi bzo 'phro bcad pas sel lo/ /de ltar gshis dang rgyas 'debs dang gnyen po dang lam du ma shor bar rang byung lhun grub mnyam nyid bde ba chen por mnyam par gzhag par bya'o// 'o na shor sa bzhi'i stong nyid blos byas kyi sgom pa 'di rnam pa kun tu mi rung ba yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ dang po'i las can rnams la chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis stong zhing zhi ba'o zhes blos byas te sgom par ma byas na byis pa dag stong pa nyid la skrag ches nas 'jug par mi 'gyur bas lung dang rigs pa sogs kyi rim pas thabs kyis bkra bkri byas nas sgom pa'ang 'gal ba med do/ /de bzhin las dang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po sgom pa dang de lam du byed pa dang spros bcas rnams kyang spros med du rgyas btab nas sgom ste rim gyis goms su 'jug pa'ang 'thad la mthar thug ni dor bar bya'o/ /des na las dang po pa rnams kyi bsgom bya dang*/ dbang po mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyi bsgom bya thog mar tshul mi mtshungs te skyes bu dar la bab pa'i kha zas byis pa chung ngu la mi 'os pa bzhin no// mdor na gang zag gi blo'i rim pa dang bstun nas sgom pa gal che'o/ /mthar ni shor sa bzhir ma shor bar lta ba'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa mngon du byas na bogs 'don gyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/

/'di dag ni lta ba'i shor sa bzhi bcad nas bogs 'don pa ste lhag mthong gi bogs 'don no/ /rgyas par byed na shor sa bzhi po so so la re re byas pas 'dir chos thun re brgyad pa'o/ /bsdoms na 'dir shor sa bzhi po bsdoms par gcig byas kyang chog go/ sgom pa'i gol sa bcad de bogs 'don pa ni/ nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum las bde ba'i nyams shas che ba la zag bcas zag med kyi bde ba so sor ma phye bar spyir gyi bde ba de nyid la shes rab kyis brtags te/ (1) de nyid bsgoms nas yang dag par zhen na 'dod pa'i khams su gol bar 'gyur te/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis kun nas dkris pa'i phyir/ der zhen nas gol yang 'dod khams gnas rigs nyi shu las ngan song gi gnas bcur ni mi skye'o/(2) /de bzhin du gsal ba'i nyams la gcig tu zhen na'ang gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun du gol lo/ (3) /de ltar du mi rtog pa la zhen kyang gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol zhing*/ (4) /de la'ang chos rnams kha dog dbyibs mtha' dbus thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha' dang 'dra zhes chos thams cad nam mkha' dang 'dra bar shes rab kyis dpyad nas de la yang dag tu bzung ste zhen cing chags par gyur na nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched du gol lo/ (5) /yang kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pas chos thams cad rnam par shes pa tsam mam sems yin snyam du de kho na la yang dag tu bden par zhen na rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched du skye'o/ (6) /de bzhin du ci yang ma grub snyam du de la zhen na'ang ci yang med pa'i skye mched du gol lo/ (7) /yod pa'ang min med pa'ang min snyam du de nyid la zhen cing mchog tu bzung na 'du shes med min gyi skye mched du skye'o/ (8) /des na de dag ni bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gang shas che ba'am mnyam yang rung ste de dag la ro myong ba dang chags zhen dang bral bar byas nas rang zhal mthong bas sel lo/

(9) /yang snying rje chen po sogs thabs la mkhas pa dang bral zhing stong rkyang la zhen na theg dman du gol 'gro zhing de spang dgos te/ dmyal bar 'gro ba byang chub la/ /gtan gyi gegs byed ma yin te/ /nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal dag /byang chub thob pa'i gtan gyi gegs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na thabs la mkhas pas brtse ba snying rje chen po dang byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas de nyid sel lo/ (10) /gzhan yang thabs kyi bogs shes rab kyis 'don na sbyin sogs dkar po'i chos rnams la 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis ma zin na zag med du mi 'gyur bas des zin par bya dgos so/ (11) /de bzhin du thabs la mkhas pas shes rab kyi phar phyin dang ldan na thabs kyis shes rab kyi bogs 'don pa zhes bya'o/ (12) /stong rkyang gis kyang theg dman du gol zhing 'gro don rlabs chen mi 'byung la snying rje kho nas kyang gzhan phan rgya chen po 'grub par mi 'gyur bas stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pas gcig gi bogs gcig gis 'don par bya dgos so/ (13) /lhag mthong med pa'i zhi gnas rkyang pa 'jig rten pa'i lam 'ba' zhig yin la/ lhag mthong skyes na thar pa'i lam du tshud pas lhag mthong gi ye shes rgyud la bskyed de zhi gnas kyi bogs lhag mthong gis 'don par bya'o/ (14) /yang zhi gnas med na lhag mthong gi rtsal mi rdzogs mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa'i yon tan mi 'char la zhi gnas ji tsam bzang rim gyis lhag mthong nus pa che zhing yon tan du ma dang ldan pas lhag mthong gi bogs zhi gnas kyis kyang 'don par bya dgos so/ (15) /rnal 'byor bzhi po'i gegs sel bogs 'don du ma byung yang yi ges 'jigs pas 'dir ma bkod kyang zur du gsal zhing khrid yig rnying pa rnams las kyang 'byung la zhi lhag de gnyis kyang rtse gcig la nyams kyi bogs nyams kyis 'don/ spros bral la stong nyid rtogs pa de snang ba rtsal sbyangs nas rtogs pa'i bogs nyams kyis 'don/

ro gcig la mnyam nyid rtogs pa de snying rjes rtsal sbyangs nas rtogs pa'i bogs rtogs pas 'don/ spyod lam thams cad du rtsal sbyangs shing sgo gsum tha mal du ma lus par ci byed dge ba'i yo lang du bsgyur nas tha mal yon tan du bogs 'don no/ (16) /nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal bar chad skyon gyi dngos po gang shar yang spang blang med par rang zhal bltas nas skyon yon tan nam ltas ngan g.yang du len pa'i sgo nas bogs 'don no/ /de la'ang dge sbyor dma' dus nyon mongs dang na tsha drag po de la bltas ma thag tu rang dge sbyor du cung mi 'gro/ de ka'i thog tu sdug bsran bskyed gnyugs bsrings nas bsdad pas rim gyis lhod lhod song nas sgom nyams dma' ba la rjes med du stong sangs 'gro/ mtho ba rnams la rang sgo ma 'gags par rang stong du rjen lhang lhang yong*/ de'i ngang nas gong du bstan pa ltar gyi so ma lhug pa rang ga'i ngang nas ma bcos par 'jog par bya'o/ (17) /rgyas par gol sa bcad pa gsum sogs bcu bdun po'i don tshan so sos bogs 'don zhing gol sa bcad la skyon sel dgos pa'i skyon sel gol sa'i skyon de rnams ma byung na ka dpe mar 'di rnams ston dgos pa'i nges pa rtags can ni med skyon gang byung de ngos bzung la skyon sel gnyen po re ston zhing bogs 'don re dogs dang gol sa bcad de thun du bsdu na 'dir chos thun re dgu pa'o// 'phrang gsum bsgral te bogs 'don pa la stong pa dgrar langs ni/ sems kyi ngo bo brtag dpyad btsal ngo bo la bltas pas gang du'ang ma grub par mthong bas chos thams cad stong nyid kho na yin pa'i phyir lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge bas ci zhig bya/ dge sdig dang las rgyu 'bras gang yang ma grub snyam du spang gnyen gang yang med par bzung ba ni nag po kha 'byams zhes bya bas lta spyod log par gyur pa yin pas stong pa dgrar langs kyi gol sa zhes bya ba yin te/

rtsa ba shes rab las/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na/ /shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// ji ltar sbrul la bzung nyes dang*/ /rig sngags log par bsgrubs pa bzhin// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na blo gros dang ldan pas stong lta had po'i skyon gyis ma gos par rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub tu zin kyang rnam par snang ba'i rtsal mdangs 'gag med 'di la rgyu 'bras dge sdig gi rten 'brel la sogs pa kun rdzob tu bslu ba med pa'i mtshang rig ste rtogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam yang spyod pa phra zhib legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel zung du 'jug pa la slob cing stong pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin lta spyod zung 'brel gyi lam la slob bo// 'o na gong du spang blang med par ma bstan nam zhe na/ de ni spang gnyen gyi 'dzin pa grol ched du yin la/ 'di ni kun rdzob tu 'am las dang po pas kyang sgra drang thad du bzung nas nag po kha 'byams su 'gyur ba dgag pa'i ched do/ /chos thun bdun cu pa'o// yang snying rje dgrar langs ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba cung zad thob pas de dang mi ldan pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje skyes te kye ma bdag gis sems can 'di rnams grol bar ma byas na bdag nyid grol ba tsam gyis bla med byang chub tu mi 'gyur te/ de'i phyir sems can 'di rnams la phan pa bsgrub bo zhes bsams nas rang nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dor nas rtsol ba dang bcas pas 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa sna tshogs la 'jug cing bdag dang sems can thams cad bden zhen gyis dub par byed pa ni snying rje dgrar langs zhes bya zhing*/ snying rje mi bzod pa skyes kyang de dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas rang gi rtogs pa dri ma med pa skyong ba la chig dril du byas te gnas skabs kyi 'du 'dzi rnam g.yeng rnams bor nas dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa nyams len kho na la brtson par bya dgos so/ /chos thun don gcig pa'o//

rgyu 'bras dgrar langs ni/ lta ba gtan la phab ste man ngag zab mo bsgoms pas gtan la ma phebs pa'am/ thams cad rtog pas byed pa mthong nas da dung yang dag pa'i don mthong ba la rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas par byas te de nas gnas lugs kyi don gtan la 'bebs par byed/ de'i phyir bdag gis shes bya thams cad la mkhas par bya'o bsams nas sgra tshad bzo sogs bya ba phran tshegs la 'jug cing zhi lhag gi rtsal sbyong rnams dor bar byed na rgyu 'bras kyi rtog pa dgrar langs kyi gol sa zhes bya zhing de dag legs par brtags te spang bar byas nas stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug zab mo'i don la rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la ma rmongs pa'i shes rab dri ma med pa shugs kyis skye zhing gcig shes kun grol zhes bya ba yin no// des na stong nyid snying rje mnyam nyid du rtogs pas rgyu 'bras gang la'ang mchog 'dzin gyi zhen pa a 'thas par gyur na mi rung bas gang la'ang ma zhen par rang gi sems mnyam nyid 'od gsal ba'i thang 'di la ma bcos par bag yangs su rol zhing brtson 'grus chig dril du bya'o/ /'di dag ni rtsal sbyang dang bogs 'don gyi rim

pa'o/ /rgyas par dgrar langs gsum po sel ched so so la thun re byas pas 'dir thun don gnyis pa'o/ /bsdu na dgrar langs gsum bsdoms par gcig bya'o// gnyis pa gegs sel la/ nad dang gdon dang ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs sel gsum las/ dang po ni/ nad thams cad rlung mkhris bad kan gsum du 'du zhing de'ang zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin gtso bor bsgoms pas rlung nad sel/ lhag mthong gi don la gtso bor nan tan byas pas bad mkhris kyi nad sel lo/ /yang na bad kan sa'i nad lhag mthong rlung dang rig pa dbyer med pa'i rlung gi shugs kyis med par byed cing*/ mkhris rlung g.yo ba'i nad rnams zhi gnas kyi ri bos gnon la/ der ma zad nad thams cad tsha grang gnyis las gyur pa yin pas zhi gnas bsil ba'i chus tsha ba me'i rang bzhin zhi bar byed cing lhag mthong nyi ma'i 'od kyis grang ba chu'i rang bzhin rnams skem zhing sreg par byed do/ /yang na tsha sogs byung na nad de'i ngo bo dbyibs byung gnas 'gro gsum dbyibs kha dog sogs zhib tu brtags shing dpyad pas rang bzhin med par rtog pas sgro btags pa tsam las cung zad tsam yang ma grub pa stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du thag bcad/ des kyang bag chags mthu brtas pa'i dbang gis ma zlog na nad 'di lta bus mnar ba'i sems can dpag tu med pa yod pas de rnams kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin cing des 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gyi go chod de sems can de rnams sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du na ru song na dga' ba sgom pa sogs gtong len gyi dmigs pa la nan tan bya'o// nad kyang sku bzhir 'khyer te sna tshogs su snang ba sprul sku/ rig pa longs sku/ stong pa ngo bo nyid sku/ de gsum ro mnyam pa chos sku'am/ nad skye ba med pa chos sku/ gnas pa med pa longs sku/ 'gag pa med pa sprul sku/ rang bzhin stong pa ngo bo nyid sku ste sku bzhir khyer te nyams su blang ngo*/

/de ltar rtsad bcad de nad dngos por ma grub pa dang*/ zlog sgom gyi gtong len byas te nad zil gyis gnon pa dang nad sku bzhi dang ye shes kyi rol par khyer te rang zhal lta ba'i rnal 'byor te rnam pa gsum gyis nad sel zhing*/ mdor bsdu na/ rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i gsungs las/ lus la na tsha byung dus su/ /sngon nas gzhan la brdeg 'tshog gi /rnam par smin pa dus 'dir smin/ /las ngan 'dzad par byed pa la/ /nad la sman pa mi 'gugs shing*/ /gdon la rim gro mi byed par/ /nad nyid lam du 'khyer dgos pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i gsung yin pas/ /nad la skyon du mi blta bar/ /sgrib pa dag cing yon tan skye/ /rtogs pa'i bogs ni 'don par byed/ /na tsha byung na shin tu dga'/ /nyams su 'di ltar long mdzod dang*/ /nga yi na tsha 'di lta bus/ /mnar ba'i sems can snying re rje/ /snyam pa yang dang yang du bsgom/ /nga yi na tsha 'di nyid kyis/ /mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /nad dang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig /ces pa'i smon lam yang yang gdab/ /de rjes nad la cer gyis blta/ /dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa'i/ /nad la dngos por grub pa med/ /stong pa nyid du lhun gyis grub/ /de ltar shes pas rang sar grol/ /yang cig na bar gyur pa na/ /rje la gsol ba dungs kyis gdab/ /lam du slongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dgag sgrub med par byin gyis rlobs/ /grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i gsol ba drag tu gdab/ /yang cig nad la cer gyis blta/ /sngar ma grub pa'i nad de nyid/ /phyis kyang grub par ga la 'gyur/ /ma grub pa la glod la zhog /nad nyid chos skur 'char ba yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams len du bya zhing*/ des kyang ma sel na kun rdzob tu sman dang man ngag gegs sel gzer lnga rlung gis 'chos pa sogs man ngag las 'byung ba ltar yang bya'o/ /chos thun don gsum pa'o// gnyis pa gdon gyi gegs sel ni/

ji skad du/ rang gi sems ni gegs yin te/ /rang gi sems ni bdud ces bya// bgegs kun rnam par rtog las byung*/ /de phyir rnam par rtog pa bcad// ces gsungs pa ltar gdon du snang ba de'ang rang gi rnam rtog gam sems kyi cho 'phrul las byung ba yin pas de rang sems su thag bcad/ sems de'ang gsal stong 'dzin med dam sku bzhir khyer la gdon de nyid sku bzhir bsgoms pas sel lo/ /'dir thun gcig byas kyang chog /bsdu na nad gdon gnyis kyi gegs sel phyogs gcig tu bstan nas 'dir don bzhi pa byas kyang yong*// gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs sel ba ni/ sgom skyon mang po yong don med cing sgom skyon thams cad bying rgod gnyis su 'du zhing de nyid sel na gong du bstan pa ltar gyi ting nge 'dzin dang spyod lam kha zas rlung lus gnad sogs kyis bying na rgod par 'gyur ba'i thabs dang rgod na bying bar 'gyur ba'i thabs la 'bad cing bying rgod gnyis ka dang bral ba'i shes pa so na gnas par bya ba la slob bo/ /yang na bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas bying rgod sel na/ bying tshe spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bstim la mos gus dungs dungs pa ngar dang bcas pas gsol ba btab/ bla ma las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas rang la thim pas bying ba'i rgyu bzhi po dus kyis bying ba spyod lam gyis bying ba grib kyis bying ba rnam smin gyis bying ba la sogs pa thams cad sings kyis dag bla ma 'od du zhu ba rang la thim pas rang lus 'od kyi gong bu zhing khams thams cad snang bar byed pa'i rnam par bsgom/ 'od de'ang nam mkhar dengs nas rig pa ngar dang bcas pa'i ngang du ye re bzhag pas sel lo/ /rgod pa la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog sngon po snying pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i rnam pa can gyi dbus su bsgom/

'dab ma bzhi la rnam snang la sogs pa'ang sku mdog de dang mtshungs pa la rang rang gi rigs kyi dpa' bo ḍā ki sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyis bskor bar bsgom/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros bla ma la zug pas sbra'i chon thag brgyangs pa bzhin phyogs mtshams thams cad du 'od zer gyis brgyangs par gsal btab ste phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag /spyir bying rgod gnyis ka lus gnad dang sems gnad la rag pas lus gnad legs par bca' ba gal che/ yang na bying rgod gang byung de ka'i ngo bo la bltas te ma bcos par bzhag pas legs par sel/ yang lus la bde ba shas chung na bla ma snang ba mtha' yas su bsgom/ gsal ba shas chung na mi bskyod pa/ mi rtog pa shas chung na rnam snang du bsgoms la gang 'dod kyi gsol ba btab pas gegs thams cad sel zhing yon tan gong 'phel du 'byung ngo*/ /'chi ba'i tshe'ang 'chi ba nyid lam gyi grogs su byas te gang la'ang zhen chags dang re dogs 'dzin pa ma zhugs par gsal stong du bsres na 'chi ba lam gyi grogs su'ang 'gyur ro/ /rgyas par nad gdon ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs sel so so la dmigs pa re byas pas chos thun don lnga pa'o/ /bsdu na 'dir gegs sel rnams bsdoms nas thun gcig byas kyang chog/ gsum pa lam bgrod tshul ni/ spyir phyag rgya chen po la lam rim gyis bgrod pa'i rtsol ba la ma ltos te/ zhang rin po ches/ phyag rgya chen po gcig chod la/ /rmongs pas sa lam rtsi ba 'khrul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang gnas skabs su gdul bya lam la bkri ched dam gang zag gi blo'i rim pa mtho dman la cig car ba dang thod rgal ba dang rim gyis pa sogs du ma 'byung ba las 'dir rim gyis pa dang go bstun nas lam bgrod tshul bstan pa la 'gal ba med pas de'i dbang du byas te rnal 'byor bzhi'i tshul gyi sa lam gong nas gong du bgrod tshul dang gong 'og gi sa mtshams sogs dang lam mngon du byed tshul ni/

zhib tu phye na rnal 'byor bzhi po rnams gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum re re la'ang so sor bzhi re sbyar du rung mod/ 'dir lam dang go bstun nas brjod na/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung las/ nyams dang rtogs pa nor ra re/ dang po rtse gcig gi nyams ni/ shes pa sing nge ba de ngo bo/ mtho dman byung na da dung nyams yin mi brtan/ mtho dman chung na bag drag /spyir rtse gcig tsam nyams yin rtogs pa min/ spros bral yang nang nas en cig skye med du shes pa la bla mas bstan pa de 'di yin par byung ang snyam nas rang sems ngo shes pa de nyams/ shes pa kho rang gis kho rang rang bzhin med par lhangs kyis rtogs pa de rtogs pa yin/ ro gcig ni/ rang gi lus phyi'i snang ba rang gi sems gsum rang bzhin med pa yin ang snyam pa nyams/ phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin so sor snang yang gcig tu lhan gyis rtogs pa de rtogs pa yin/ nan ltar bsgom bya sgom byed mi 'dug snyam pa nyams/ shes pa kho rang gis kho rang bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bar lhan gyis rtogs pa de rtogs pa yin nyams dang rtogs pa gnyis ma nor ba gal che gsungs/ rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ni/ sems kyi ngo bo gsal bar mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa de'i sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa rig pa gsal sing nge ye re ba'i nyams 'char zhing de las bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams gsum yang 'byung la/ de yang ma goms pa dang goms pa dang shin tu goms pa'i dbang gis chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum du 'gyur te/ yun thung ba dang ring ba dang ji tsam 'dod pa'i bar du gnas pa la de ltar brjod pas so// rtse gcig chung ngu ni/ sems bcas bcos med par bzhag tsa na mngon 'gyu'i rtog pa 'gags bde gsal mi rtog par song nas sems rtse gcig tu zin 'ong*/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang ma thob pas res bsgoms kyang mi 'ong res ma bsgoms kyang 'ong res gsal res mi gsal/

de'i dus su rtogs pa ma thob nges shes chen po ma skyes/ des kyang dang ba 'dren nus ye shes kyi mgo tsam dang lam gyi sna tsam yin/ rtse gcig gi nyams 'di rnams dper na tshes gcig gi zla ba zur tsam mthong ba dang 'dra sems ma bcos par bzhag pas bde sing nge bar gnas te bshig mi 'dod pa 'byung bas de ma bshig na sgom don mthun mi skye bas bshig ste rtog pa mi 'gegs par rtog pa gang skyes rang bzhin med par rang ngo shes te gtan la phab par bya'o// de'ang rtse gcig chung ngu'i dus sems gsal stong dang bde nyams dang bcas pa'i nges bzung can yod la de'i ngang nas rnam rtog shar tshe rang dwangs su 'gro zhing sgom yin snyam pa'i blos byas kyi nges shes kyang 'ong*/ rjes snang du a 'thas kyi dran pa bya ba 'ong bas dga' spro dang bcas pa'i snang ba phal cher a 'thas su 'char/ dran pas nam zin nyams dang bcas te stong pa dang sems snang yin snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs dang rmi lam sngar las gsal dwangs thon tsam ma gtogs khyad cher mi 'byung*/ res sgom mi yong ba 'dra snyam pa'i mnyam par 'jog dka' ba dang 'phel 'grib che zhing mos gus dag snang snying rje cher 'gro /chos thun don drug pa'o// 'bring po ni/ res ma bsgoms kyang ting nge 'dzin der 'gro zhing bsgoms pa'i tshe brtan por 'ong ba ste bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin de sbyangs pa'i dwangs cha la zag bcas kyi mngon shes rdzu 'phrul yon tan du ma ston nus pa ste nyams de'i ngang nas rnam rtog sngar bas 'char ba nyung zhing gang shar de rang dwangs su 'gro /rjes snang du gsal stong gi nyams dang bcas pa'i snang ba gu yangs pa nam dran sgom du 'char/ res a 'thas su 'char/ rmi lam sngar bas grangs nyung du 'gro/ nyams des res sleb res mi sleb sgom la brod pa chen po yong ngo*/ /chos thun don bdun pa'o// rtse gcig chen po ni/ mnyam rjes dang spyod lam rnam bzhi nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu rgyun chad med par gsal stong gi ngang la chal gyis 'gro

/gsal stong bde nyams dang bcas pa'i nyams rgyun chad med par 'char zhing rnam rtog thams cad dang rjes snang dang rmi lam thams cad kyang de'i ngang du song*/ sems nyid bde stong rig stong snang stong gsal stong sogs stong nyams dang thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i myong ba mang po gtso bor 'char/ zag bcas kyi yon tan du ma dang 'di bas bzang ba'i sgom med pas sgom med chen po yin nam snyam pa 'byung yang nyams rtogs de dag la ma zhen par rnam rtog gsal stong dang snang ba snang stong du rtogs te/ thams cad sems sems skye med rang grol du yid ches pa'i nges shes kyi dran pa rnyed cing mngon 'gyu'i rtog pa 'gags shing bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skye/ gsal stong de'i ngang la nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu 'gro zhing 'khor ba la zhen pa log rtog med la ngo bo mthong nas bsgom du med par song na rtse gcig gi rtsal rdzogs yon tan skyes ngo bo mthong ba yin pas de ltar ma byung gi bar du brtson pa bskyed nas nyams su blang ngo*/ /'di'i spang bya ni 'dod yon lnga yin pas tshe 'di la zhen pa longs spyod la zhen pa ting nge 'dzin la zhen pa sogs spangs te gtsang sbra dang ldan pas dben par gnas par bya dgos la/ 'di'i mnyam rjes gnyis kyi khyad par ni gnas mi gnas kyis 'byed de bde gsal mi rtog par gnas pa de mnyam bzhag /de la mi gnas na rjes thob yin no/ /chos thun don brgyad pa'o// gnyis pa spros bral ni/ de yang gnas thog tu bde na rtse gcig yin la rtse gcig gi nyams de la ma zhen par bskyangs pas ji zhig na sgom dran 'dzin gyi rtsol ba la ma ltos par gnas 'gyu gnyis dang sems kyi ngo bo lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang rnam rtog skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du rtogs/ chos thams cad spros pa dang bral bar bcos min du go /nyams thams cad yul med stong par song*/

rig pa'i ngo bo de shun pa bshus pa'am gter rnyed pa ltar spros pa dang bral bar rjen lhang gis rtogs/ sems la rang dbang thob pa snyam byed cing 'di kho na yin par 'dug pa dang po nas ngo shes thang ba la snyam pa dang nyams la'ang 'phel 'grib cher mi 'byung gal te byung yang dga' sdug med/ phyi'i snang ba la sems btang na thams cad sgyu ma lta bur 'char/ yang stong par 'gro ma song kyang 'gal ba med/ de ni snang la ma nges pa ste sgro 'dogs dang bral bar nges shes skyes pa de ltar yin par 'dug snyam pa'i rtogs pa skye zhing zhi lhag zung du chud de rnam rtog gi mtshan ma rang sar grol bas rtog pa chos skur 'char/ snang ba yang rang gi sems su rtogs/ sems nyid chos skur shes/ lta ba stong nyid shas che bas snang ba 'di yang stong pa med cing ma grub pa zhig tu gshis byed cing stong thog tu bde/ rgyu 'bras dang stong pa shas cher rtogs pa ni spros bral gyi rnal 'byor zhes bya zhing*/ de la'ang chung 'bring chen po gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni/ snang sems rig pa'i ngo bo skye 'gag dang bral ba tsam rtogs kyang stong phyogs la nges shes kyi 'dzin pa'i 'khris shig zhugs shing de dang ma bral bas nyams rtogs kyi shan cher ma phyed/ rjes shes su dran pas ma zin pa'i dus dgra gnyen du 'dzin pa ma 'gags shing yul thog tu 'dzin pa ma chod pas tshogs drug gi snang ba gang shar la legs par 'dzin pa chags/ mi legs par 'dzin pa sdang*/ rmongs se 'dug pa gti mug pa yin pas dge mi dge gang rung gi 'dzin pa 'byung ste/ phyag chen gyi nyams len dang bral na mi dge ba/ ma bral na dge ba yin pa'i phyir skabs 'dir lung ma bstan ni bden pa mthong ba la cher mi 'byung bar gsungs/ gnyid dang rmi lam yang 'khrul shas che tsam yong*/ dge sbyor la mtho dman cung zad 'byung ngo*/ /chos thun don dgu pa'o//

spros bral 'bring ni/ sngar sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i myong tshor rags pa dang stong 'dzin gyi dri ma rags pa de dag nas/ dga' tshor ram zhen pa dang bral zhing tha mal gyi shes pa yul med du lhang song*/ snang stong gi 'dzin pa nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral rang sar rang ngo shes tsam gyis chog /da dung phyi rol yul la cung zad 'phrig ma tshud pas snang thog tu cung mi bde/ snang ba 'di gang nas byung ba yin stong pa yin yang snang ba 'di 'gags te gtan bral du ma song snyam pa sogs re dogs phran bu yong*/ rjes shes dang rmi lam gyi tshe 'khrul ma 'khrul sna tshogs 'byung*/ de'i rjes shes ngo shes pa de la zer/ mnyam gzhag ngo shes kyi ngang la rtsol med du gnas pa de'o/ /chos thun brgyad cu pa'o// spros bral chen po ni/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad la sgro 'dogs chod de snang ba rang sems su shes/ sems snang la rang bzhin med pa yul dmigs gtad dang bral zhing nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur bde cham gyis rtogs/ sngar snang thog tu ma bde rig thog tu bde nyams len rig thog tu byed pa de/ 'dir snang ba sems su shes sems stong par shes snang bas stong pa'i go chod stong pa la sgom gyi gtso bo byed stong thog tu sgro 'dogs chod pas chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa'am ma grub pa 'di la da ltar gyi snang thog so ma nyams pa 'di cung mi bde/ snang ba 'di gzhi med 'khrul snang du 'dod pa 'byung*/ 'di'i skabs su nyin par sgom la rgyun chad med mtshan mo rmi lam du 'dzin pa de la rjes shes su 'khrul pa dang rtog pa du+u ma re 'char/ de 'byung ba'ang gnyid kyis dran 'dun nyams pas lan pa yin/ yul rkyen drag pos dkrugs pa'i dus su'ang rjes shes su cung zad 'gro ba'ang 'byung 'di yan chad la sgom skyes bdag po med par ma song na dus kun tu 'bral med du yong*/

dran pa rgyun chad med par mi yong bar bzung dran la cung zad ltos pas dran pa gal che/ spros bral mnyam rjes dran pas 'byed/ spros bral dang 'khor 'das kyi bar na dran ma dran las med/ gdams ngag gi gtso bo dran pa yin/ gang shar la 'dzin pa ma zhugs na zhe sdang kar re ba'ang rang stong yin/ ngo ma shes shing 'dzin pa zhugs na nyon mongs dang rnam rtog med pa ltar snang yang ma rig pa yin/ de ngo shes dang ma bral tshe nyon mongs su snang ba rgyun chad med kyang dgag sgrub tu byar med de de'i rtags su gang shar las stong pa logs su 'tshol ba'i blo mi skye/ rtog pa dag pa'i rjes kyi shes pa'i 'char sgo dwangs sing nge ba de'i ngang du dus rtag tu 'gro ba mi yong bas bzung dran la bltos ring rtog pa re la dran pa res zin pa'ang dka'/ des na dran pa rgyun chad med par bsten/ nyin par gyi rkyen gyis mi gnod par gyur na spros bral chen po rtogs pa zhes bya'o// de'ang sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag dang bral bar rtogs blo 'das su mthong*/ 'jig rten blos thengs gzhan la phrag mi dog mngon shes sogs du ma'i yon tan 'char rjes thob snang ba sgyu mar 'char byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin rtogs re dogs dang bral 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba chod/ mthong spang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis spangs 'khor bar phyir mi ldog smon lam dbang gis ma gtogs srid par las dbang gis mi skye na spros bral gyi ngo bo mthong zhing rtsal rdzogs yon tan skyes pa zhes bya'o/ /rtse gcig dang spros bral gyi khyad par rnam rtog chos skur rtogs ma rtogs yin/ 'dir yang zhen pa gsum btang ste dben pa dang 'dag sbyar dgon pa bsten pa dang smra bcad bya'o/ /chos thun gya gcig pa'o// gsum pa ro gcig ni/ sngar spros bral gyi skabs kyi chos thams cad rang bzhin ma grub pa'am stong thog tu bde/ gang shar gyi rnam rtog so ma'am snang thog tu cung mi bde ba de dag nas 'khor 'das gnyis su 'dres zhes pa de yong ba yin/

de'i don yang ma 'gags pa'i snang ba so ma 'di la snang bar 'dzin pa'i dngos 'dzin kyang med/ stong par zhen pa'i stong zhen kyang med/ phyi rol gyi snang ba 'di rang gi blos rang bzhin med par sgom pa'am gnyis su snang ba'i chos gang yang ma grub/ blos gzhal ba tsam ma yin par snang mi snang stong mi stong snang dmigs stong pa bskyed rdzogs kun rdzob don dam 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa sogs mdor na bde sdug sogs gnyis bsdus kyi chos ji snyed pa thams cad tha mi dad par dbyer med zung 'jug ro gcig par rtogs te lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su shar/ gang shar gyi snang ba so ma rtog pa so ma la dgag sgrub dang bral/ rang rig rang gsal rtsol med yang dag gi dran pas sems dang dran pa snang ba gsum me dang tsha ba bzhin dang rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mngon du gyur snang thog tu'ang bde ba ni ro gcig gi rnal 'byor zhes bya/ de la'ang chung 'bring chen po gsum las/ dang po ni/ snang stong dbyer med du 'dres thams cad gnyug ma'i rang bzhin du rtogs stong mi stong med par gang shar gyi shes pa so ma de kas chog /chos su rtogs/ snang stong gang rung re'i thog tu yang lam gyi chos ji snyed pa tshang bar rtogs kyang lus snang sems gsum dbyer mi phyed res sems su nges pa tsug yong*/ der myong rgyu dang 'dzin pa'i nges shes cung zad yod/ rjes shes su sa sogs sra 'thas can du snang ba dang yul rkyen drag pos dkrugs pa'i tshogs drug gi snang ba la dge sbyor du mi bde ba dang gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba du+u ma re yod pa dang chos byed pa la ngo lkog cung mi thub pa 'dra ba'ang 'byung*/ rjes snang sgyu ma lta bu zhes bya zhing rmi lam na yang 'khrul pa dang 'dzin pa du ma re 'byung*/ res lus snang sems gsum dbyer med pa'i nyams kyang 'byung*/ rgyu 'bras la rtsi 'jog dang mos gus snying rje chung ba 'dra yang srid pas der ma song bar bya/

chos thun gya gnyis pa'o// ro gcig 'bring ni/ sngar gyi myong ba nges shes kyi 'dzin pa'i cha gcig 'dre bas de dag nas bem po phyir ma lus/ rig pa nang du ma lus snang sems zung 'jug gcig tu krong nge ba gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba rbad kyis chod/ 'dzin pa de'ang yul la brten nas skye ba las 'dir gzung yul thams cad gnyug ma rang gsal du shar bas de med tsa na 'dzin byed kyi shes pa dang bral/ 'dzin pa yul thog tu 'char ba'i shes pa gcig gi grogs su thams cad 'char/ gzugs sogs yul rnams mi rtog par 'char bas gzung 'dzin de yul thog tu 'char/ ro gcig chung ngu dang zung 'jug gi ngo bo la khyad med kyang myong ba brtan du song ba yin/ lus snang sems gsum gcig tu 'dres pa'i nyams 'byung*/ rjes shes dang rmi lam yang sngar bas 'khrul pa chung zhing a 'thas kyi 'dzin pa yang cher mi yong*/ 'on kyang rmi lam mam dus gzhan du yang rung yang dag gi dran pas yengs ma yengs su 'dzin pa'i gnyis snang sgyu ma lta bu bya ba yad yud yong ba yin/ gzung dran dang yang dag gi dran pa'i khyad par yengs dus su yengs 'dug snyam pa'i rjes la dge sbyor rgyud thog tu yer yong ba de gzung dran yin zhing sngar 'dzin pa zhugs pa'i rtags yin/ rtog 'dzin de med par dran pa tsam gyis nyams len gyi steng du yer yong ba de rtogs chos yang dag gi dran pa bya ba yin te sngar nges shes kyis ma zin kyang 'dzin pa ma zhugs pa'i rtags yin/ chos thun gya gsum pa'o// ro gcig chen po ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad skye med du mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du rtogs/ snang sems gcig tu nges shing sngar gyi de ka myong ba brtan du song nas snang ba ma 'gags pa 'di la bden 'dzin dag pas gnyis med kyi rtogs pa de nyin mtshan 'khor mar 'byung*/ mi rtog pa'i 'char sgo gsal tsam gyi snang la ma nges pa'i myong tshor cung zad re 'byung*/

'dzin med kyi gsal snang mi 'gags/ res 'khor 'das la sogs pa snang tshad rtogs pa de'i ngo bor shar nas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa rgyun chad/ ngos 'dzin med pa'i rjes snang sgyu ma lta bu tsam zhig yod/ de'ang sgyu ma mkhan po'i snang ba dang 'dra ste med par shes bzhin gnyis snang phra mo mi 'gags/ 'dzin med kyi rmi lam kyang 'al 'ol tsam 'byung res rmi lam mi 'byung ba'ang yod/ 'di'i gnyis snang ni 'char sgo phra mo rnams nyams len gyi ngang du dag pa'i mdangs sam gsal snang ngam stong snang du yad yud 'byung ba de la ro gcig gi rjes stong par 'char ba zer/ don la spang bya'i lhag rol yin pas sgom gyi myong tshor yod ring la de la ltos pa'i gzhan zhig shugs la yong bas gnyis snang phra mo ma dag pa yin yang mi rtog pa'i 'char sgo 'ga' zhig snang la ma nges pa'am rang rtsal du+u ma shar bas dran pas yengs ma yengs su khyad par byas pa'i 'char sgo rkyang pa mi bde bar gsal tsam gyi myong tshor dam dum 'byung ste spang bya'i lhag ma yin/ de yod ring de la ltos pa'i phra mo de ma yin pa gzhan zhig kyang shugs la 'byung bas ro gcig chen po'i sgyu ma phra mo de la zer/ des na gang shar gyi snang ba la spang blang dgag sgrub med cing mnyam nyid gnyug ma yul med gsal stong du rang ngo shes/ 'khor 'das la sogs pa gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad ro gcig tu rtogs pa dang 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms rten 'brel mtha' dag 'char/ snang thog tu bde na ro gcig gi ngo bo mthong zhing rtsal rdzogs yon tan skyes pa zhes bya'o/ /spros bral dang ro gcig gi khyad par snang ba sgom du shar ma shar dang stong nyid kyi gzung dran la ltos mi ltos dang snang ba rang sems su shes pa dang snang ba sgom du shar ba sogs kyi khyad par yong rtsol med zer yang sgom med la ltos pa'i rtsol ba cung zad yong*/ spros bral nas gzung 'dzin skye med kyi ngang du zhi zhing 'dir rjes kyi dus su'ang zhi ba yin/

'di'i mnyam rjes 'dzin mi 'dzin dang gnyid kyis 'byed do/ /ro gcig gsum gyi skabs su phal cher dben pa bsten/ skabs su tshogs su'ang bsdad nas bogs 'don/ sgom mi sgom khyad med snyam yang yang dag gi dran pas sgom pa gal che'o/ /chos thun gya bzhi pa'o// bzhi pa sgom med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ de la goms shing 'dris par byas pas ro gcig chen po man chad rjes shes la gnyis snang sgyu ma tsam de dag /rtogs chos yang dag gi dran pa ma yengs tsam dang stong 'dzin gyi dri ma cung zad yod pa dang yang dag gi dran pa'i rtsol ba zi ba yod pa dang gnyis snang phra mo de thams cad dag nas lhun grub kyi rang sa zin bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bar rtogs/ ci byas kyang bde ba ma bsgoms kyang rgyun chad med par sgom du 'char mnyam par bzhag ma bzhag dran pas zin ma zin yengs ma yengs la mi ltos par sgom du 'char/ blo gshis thog tu dag /bsgom pa'i 'od gsal dang shi ba'i 'od gsal ma bu gnyis gcig tu 'dres nam mkha' la sprin dwangs pa'am chu rlabs dang bral ba bzhin 'od gsal gnyis gcig tu 'dres chos sku 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ spang blang dang bya byed bral shi ma shi med snyam pa dang mnyam rjes med pa'i nges shes lhangs kyis skyes/ gzhan snang du mkha' 'gros bskor ba lus du mar mthong ba mos gus can gyi gang zag la sangs rgyas rang snang la shar/ ngag ci byas kyang chos su 'gro /lus ci byas kyang sems can dad/ gnas gar bsdad kyang byin rlabs skye/ gcig pur bsdad kyang skyo dub med/ lung pa gar phyin pa der bde legs 'byung*/ res byis pa'i spyod pa dang 'jig rten la dga' 'dug snyam pa gzhan snang la yong*/ byang sems brtan/ las 'bras mngon sum du gyur thams cad skye med du rtogs gang la'ang zhen pa med gtsang btsog dang ngo tsha'i rnam rtog med/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis mchod pa 'bul zhing sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs byed sems can thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bur 'gyur ro//

de la'ang chung 'bring chen po gsum las/ dang po ni/ dran pas gzung ma dgos par ci byas kyang sgom du shar bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral mnyam par bzhag ma bzhag la ma ltos par sgom du 'char/ gong gi ro gcig chen po'i dus kyi rjes snang sgyu ma lta bu de'ang phra mor song nas yang dag gi dran pas kyang gzung mi dgos kho rang rang dag la 'gro /rjes snang ma rtog pa ngo ma shes zhes bya ba nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog thams cad ro gcig man chad du dag pa'i ma rig pa'i lhag ma kun gzhi'i rnam shes rtog bral lung ma bstan du gnas pa de ye shes su ma gyur tsam gyi nus pa med pa'i spang bya rabs chad po rtog med rang ngo ma shes pa tsam zhig yod pa de'ang ma rig pa'i cha nas sgyu ma lta bu dus thung bas skad cig ma re 'byung de rang gi ngo bo mi rtog par yod pa gnyen po bsten mi dgos/ gnyid dus su'ang res 'ga' 'dzin pa'i dri ma cung zad tsam 'byung yang srid pa rang gsal du ma shar bas shes bya la sgrib bo/ /chos thun gya lnga pa'o// sgom med 'bring po ni/ lhun grub kyi rang sa tsir gyis zin sngar bas myong ba brtan du song 'khor 'das gnyis ye nas lhun grub tu gnas pa de mngon du gyur/ 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral gnyug ma'i rang sa zin nas nyin mtshan med par mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi 'khor los bsgyur te mnyam gzhag gam ye shes de'i shugs kyis 'phangs pa'i rjes snang mi rtog ngo ma shes kyi cha phra zhing sngar bas phra ba yul la spyad long med pa se gol gtog tsam du snang ba sgyu ma lta bu rang gsal du grol/ dus thams cad du ngo bo mi rtog pa rang gsal du ma shar tsam gyi gnas ngan len gyi dri ma rang rjes phra mo tsam dang bcas pa'i mnyam gzhag thams cad zag med/ rjes snang nyams su len pa'i 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po sogs zag bcas yin no/ /chos thun gya drug pa'o// sgom med chen po ni/

rnam shes thams cad ye shes su gnas gyur/ ye shes kyi ral gris shes bya'i sgrib pa gnas ngan len gyi dri ma dang bcas pa rtsad nas bcad de chos dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa ma'i 'od gsal dang me long lta bu'i ye shes bu'i 'od gsal gnyis 'dres mi slob pa'i zung 'jug bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du gyur mnyam rjes med/ gnyug ma ma bcos pa'i thog tu sleb pa rang don chos sku gnyug ma'i rang rtsal phyogs med du 'byongs pa/ gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro don mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i lam mngon du byas pa'o/ /sgom med la mnyam rjes cher 'byed rgyu med phal cher mnyam gzhag las ma g.yos pa'o// des na dran rgyu dang sgom rgyu med par myong ba dag /nges shes la sogs pa'i dran 'dzin gyi rtsol ba dang bral chos nyid zad sar 'khyol/ snang ba la bden 'dzin bral sgom med 'bring nas zag med kyi rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston nus pa na sgom med kyi ngo bo mthong ba dang rtsal rdzogs yon tan skyes pa zhes bya'o/ /ro gcig dang sgom med gnyis rjes shes sgyu ma lta bu dang yang dag gi dran pa bsten dgos mi dgos kyi khyad par yod do/ /spros bral yan chad ngo bo la na 'phar rgyu med/ chos thun gya bdun pa'o//

rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis po de lam dang sbyar na/ rtse gcig chung ngu tshogs lam/ 'bring nyams gsal stong 'dra ba de dran pas zin na rgyun du yong ma zin na'ang res yong ba de sbyor lam drod rtse zer te mthong lam spros bral gyi ye shes kyi me skye ba'i snga ltas su gyur pa dang sngar gsal snang med pa la 'dir chos nyid kyi gsal snang cung zad skye zhing nyams dag nas rtogs pa 'bur la khad yin pas so/ /chen po nyams 'khor yug rtog pa thams cad de'i ngang du thim nyin mtshan med par gsal stong nam mkha' lta bur 'char sgom med du sleb snyam pa sogs 'byung ba de sbyor lam bzod pa dang chos mchog yin te/ chos nyid kyi gsal snang la brtan pa thob de yang mchog tu goms pas 'jig rten pa'i lam du skye ba'i mngon par rtogs pa thams cad mchog tu gyur mthong lam spros bral gyi rtogs pa skye ba la mngon du phyogs pas so/ /'dis tshogs lam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis/ sbyor lam nges 'byed cha mthun bzhi la sogs pa rnams 'thob pa yin no/ /spros bral ni/ gong gi nyams de bshig gin bskyangs bla ma la gsol ba dungs dungs btab gang shar gyi steng du 'dzin med ma bcos pa'i ngang du bzhag pas rtse gcig gi nyams de dag nas spros bral 'char zhing de shar ma thag tu mthong lam thob/ chos thams cad skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar rtogs pa des yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten byed pa la dga' ba khyad par can skye bas sa dang po rab tu dga' ba zhes bya/ des na spros bral chung ngu thob ma thag pa de la mthong lam thob pa zhes zer ro// de yang chos thams cad spros bral du rtogs pas nyon mongs pa sgom spang gi dri ma bral bas sgom lam sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa zhes pa thob bo/ /sems skye 'gag dang bral ba ye nas yod pa de bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi 'od kyis mngon du byas pas sa gsum pa 'od byed pa zhes pa thob bo/

/rtsa bral gyi rtogs pa de la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing sems can gyi don grub pas sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba zhes pa'ang thob bo/ /stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rtogs pa des bag chags kyi dri ma sbyang dka' ba rnams sbyangs pas sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba zhes pa thob bo/ /spros bral chen po nar son pa'i rtogs pas 'khor 'das gnyis ka skye med du mngon du gyur pas sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa zhes pa thob bo/ /de nas bdag gzhan 'khor 'das thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ro gcig chung ngu rgyud la skyes pa dang zung 'jug gi rtogs pa des stong phyogs la zhen pa'i nyan rang gi sa thag bsring ba'am de las ring du song*/ 'gro sa'i sa brgyad pa dang 'brel bar byed pas sa bdun pa ring du song ba thob bo/ /'bring po gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod pa rgyud la skyes na gnyis chos de thams cad gnyug ma rang gsal du shar ba tha dad 'dzin pa'i 'du shes kyis ma g.yos pas sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba zhes pa thob pa'o/ /ro gcig chen po rjes snang sgyu mar 'char ba de rgyud la skyes na zung 'jug gi rtogs pa de la goms pas sgom byung gi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa las so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la sogs pa yon tan gyi legs tshogs thams cad 'byung bas sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros zhes pa thob bo/ /de nas bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bar rtogs pa'i sgom med chung ngu rgyud la skyes pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan thams cad sprin gtibs pa bzhin 'byung bas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes bya ba thog mar thob/ sgom med 'bring po lhun grub kyi rang sa tsir gyis zin shes sgrib rtsa ba nas dag pa de la sa bcu pa'i nang gi rgyun mtha'i khyad par gyi lam zhes pa 'thob/ mi rtog pa'i ngo bo skad cig mar ngo ma shes pa'i gnas ngan len gyi dri ma dang spang bya thams cad spangs rtogs bya mtha' dag rtogs 'od gsal ma bu gcig tu 'dres pa'i sgom med chen po rgyud la skyes na mthar phyin pa bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'o/

/sa dang spyi yoms su sbyar na rtse gcig gsum tshogs sbyor/ spros bral gsum byang chub kyi yan lag bdun mthong lam sa dang po rab tu dga' ba/ ro gcig sgom lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa sa dgu pa/ sgom med mthar phyin lam sa bcu gcig kun tu 'od dang yang sbyar nas gsungs/ 'o na mthong lam thob pa dang spros bral rtogs pa dus mnyam na/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs ston mi nus pa ci zhes rtog ge ba dag zer na/ de ni skyon med de yon tan rnams goms pa brtas pa dang rim gyis 'byung ste/ zhang rin po ches/ ngo bo mthong ma thag nyid du/ /sdug bsngal spangs par ma gyur cing*/ /yon tan nus pa ma skyes kyang*/ /chos min zhes su su zhig smod/ /nyi ma shar ma thag nyid du/ /chab rom zhu bar ma nus shing*/ /sa rdo dro bar ma gyur kyang*/ /nyi ma min zhes su zhig smod/ /sa dang lam gyi rim pa dang*/ /drod rtags khyad par so so kun/ /rim 'jug gdul bya drang don du/ /thub pas ldem por gsungs pa la/ /rmongs rnams nyi tshe phyogs char zhen/ /gdul bya'i mtho dman bsam mi khyab/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab bsam mi khyab/ /rang gi chos dang ma mthun yang*/ /smad cing spang bar mi bya ste/ /nam zhig go bar smon lam thob/ /ces dang*/ rgod tshang pas/ gzhan yang snang srid 'di la 'gal tshul zhig yod de/ khyed mtshan nyid pa'i blo khog tu mi shong*/ yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis po de rtogs ldan gyi rang snang yin/ gang zag dang las kyi mthun snang tsam las mi mngon par gda' ba sprul pa yang de dang 'dra bar bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston nus zhes dang*/ au rgyan pas/ spros bral mthong lam yin na yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs mi 'dug pas 'gal ba la sogs pa de rnams la nges pa chen po mi 'ong ste mtshan nyid nas kyang mthong lam gyi yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis po gdul bya dag ma dag thams cad la ston nus pa ma yin la/

phar phyin du 'jig rten pa'i lam la sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis mthong lam gyi dus su yon tan gyi drod rtags mang po 'thob pa yin la/ 'dir gdams pa zab mo dang bla ma'i mos gus kyis lam btsan chod du bgrod pas mngon gyur gyi drod rtags tsho ma thon yang lam gyi go ma chod pa ma yin la/ gdul bya dag pa la drod rtags ston nus pa'ang mi khegs pa lags/ drod rtags yod med dang nus pa che chung gis lam yin min gyi tshod 'dzin pa'ang ma yin te/ de lta na phar phyin pa la/ sngags bla na med pa'i sa lam gyi yon tan cha shas tsam yang med de/ mtshan nyid kyi lam gyis sa lam gyi go mi chod par gnas 'gro/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i lam rim dang phar phyin gyi sa lam gyi 'gal ba yang des 'dum 'tshal/ zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs pa bzhin du nyams su blang dgos kyi de ltar ma yin par the tshom dang som nyi brtag dpyad rkyang pas dus 'da' ba ma gtogs nyams len gnad du ma bsnun pas rtog ge pa dang mtshan nyid pa rnams thal rtsed rtse yin dbu nag rdog ge bzhugs 'dug pa des lan par gda'/ phar phyin bcu la'ang sbyar te spros bral chung ngu'i dus kyi sa rab dga' thob dus sbyin pa'i phar phyin la nyams len du bya zhing slob par byed pa nas sgom med 'bring por ye shes kyi phar phyin la nyams len bya zhing slob par byed pa sogs shes par bya'o/ /chos thun gya brgyad pa'o// rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dang sa lam sbyar tshul 'di gnyis rje rgod tshang pa'i bzhed pa'i gting mthil phyin rtogs pa min kyang 'ol tshod la 'di bzhin yin pa 'dra bsam pa'i mos blos yar gzhal tsam ste/ de'i gsung la slob bu dam pa 'gas zin bris su bgyis pa las/ rtse gcig chung ngu 'di'i yon tan dang nyams len la tshogs lam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis brtsis te/ zhes dang*/ rtse gcig 'bring po myong ba brtan du song nas nyams gsal stong nam mkha' 'dra ba de dran pas zin na rgyun du yang yong res ma zin yang yong 'di ka la drod dang rtse mo yang zer te/

zhes dang*/ rtse gcig chen po nyams kyi 'khor yug ces pa rtog pa thams cad nyams de'i thog tu thim nas nyin mtshan med par gsal stong nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu 'char sgom med kyi rnal 'byor du sleb snyam pa 'byung bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skye zag bcas kyi mngon shes la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi yon tan thams cad 'char tshul 'di la bzod pa dang chos mchog ces kyang zer te/ zhes dang*/ spros bral dang po skyes ma thag gi skad cig ma mthong lam de nas bzung ste sgom med 'bring po man chad sgom lam ste/ zhes dang*/ spros bral dang po rtogs pa la chos thams cad skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar rtogs pa des yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten byed pa la dga' ba khyad par can skye bas sa dang po rab tu dga' ba zer/ zhes dang*/ chos thams cad spros bral du rtogs pas nyon mongs pa sgom spangs kyi dri ma bral bas sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa zer/ zhes dang*/ sems skye 'gag thams cad dang bral bar ye nas yod pa de bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis mngon du byed pa las gsum pa 'od byed pa zer/ zhes dang*/ rtsa bral gyi rtogs pa de la sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing sems can gyi don grub pa la sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba zer/ zhes dang*/ bag chags kyi dri ma sbyang dka' ba rnams sbyangs pas sa lnga pa sbyang dka' ba zer/ spros bral chen po nar son pa'i rtogs pas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gnyis ka skye med du mngon du gyur pas sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa zer/ sgom lam la zag bcas zag med kyi dbye ba spros bral 'bring po sa dang sbyar na sa bdun pa ring du song ba'i sa yin te/ zhes dang*/ sa dang bstun na sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'i sa yin te chos rje'i zhal nas/ ro gcig sa ni brgyad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs/ zhes dang*/ ro gcig chen po sgyu ma phra mo bya ba de la 'dod pa yin gsungs pa dang sbyar na sa dgu pa yongs su rdzogs pa bcu pa thob ma thag pa de yin te/

du ma ro gcig sa bcu'i rtogs pa 'char gsungs kyang 'di ni don la sa dgu pa rang yin bcu pa'i mtshan gsol ba tsam las med gsungs/ zhes dang*/ sgom med dang po rtogs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan thams cad sprin ltar gtibs pas sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes bya/ zhes dang*/ sgom med 'bring po lhun grub kyi rang sa tsir gyis zin te sngar bas myong ba brtan du song zhes pa nas rang gsal du shar ba'i grol ba de la sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma khyad par gyi lam zer/ zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa dang*/ sgom med chen po 'od gsal ma bu 'dres nas mnyam gzhag rjes thob med cing gnyug ma ma bcos thog tu sleb pas rang don chos sku thob/ gnyug ma'i rang rtsal phyogs med du 'byongs pas gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du 'gro don mdzad pa 'di la bcu gcig kun tu 'od zer te/ chos rjes/ sgom med bcu gcig mthar phyin lam/ /zhes gsungs pas lam lnga las mthar phyin pa'i lam ste/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin du bsgrigs pa yin la 'on kyang ti gu sbreng gi phar phyin theg pa'i lam dang sbyar kyang chad lhag med par rang 'grig dka' de ma 'grig pa la skyon yang med de 'dir rten 'brel 'grig na tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya la phar phyin theg par grangs med gsum gyis 'tshang rgya ba gnyis la khyad par yod pa'i phyir/ rgod tshang pa'i bzhed pa rnam pa du ma yod pa las gcig la/ tshogs bsags pa tshogs lam dang las dang po pa'i sa/ rtse gcig sbyor lam dang mos spyod/ spros bral mthong lam dang sa dang po ro gcig sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar sgom med chung 'bring sa lhag ma gsum ste de rnams sgom lam sgom med chen po mthar phyin pa sangs rgyas kyi sar yang bzhed/ 'ga' zhig rnal 'byor bcu gnyis la nyams rtogs so sor dbye bas nyer bzhir phye nas nyams kyi rnal 'byor bcu gnyis sbyor lam rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bcu gnyis kyi rtse gcig gsum sa dang po gsum/

spros bral gsum bzhi pa lnga pa drug pa/ ro gcig gsum bdun pa brgyad pa dgu pa/ sgom med gsum bcu pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar du sbyor ba'ang yod/ yang 'ga' zhig dang por lam la zhugs pa nas bzung rtse gcig gsum tshogs lam dang las dang po pa'i sa/ spros bral gsum sbyor lam dang mos spyod kyi sa/ ro gcig gsum dang sgom med chung 'bring mthong sgom nas sa bcu pa'i bar sgom med chen po mthar phyin sangs rgyas kyi sar bzhag na legs te/ spros bral chen po'i skabs su ro mnyam zung 'jug gi rtogs pa cung zad med de/ de med par chos nyid kyi don ji lta bar mi rtogs pas spros bral sa dang po dang mthong lam du bzhag na cung mi bde/ sngar de ltar gsungs pa rnams ni spros bral mthar phyin pa zhig la dgongs der stong 'dzin sogs nyams myong gi zhen 'dzin thams cad dag nas zung 'jug ro mnyam gyi rtogs pa 'char bas deng sang gi rnam bzhag 'chad skabs kyi spros bral chung 'bring mthong lam du bzhag na de'i nyams myong dang sa tshod 'grig dka' bar sems so/ /zhes kyang bzhed pas de dag la dpyod ldan dag gis dpyod cing rang gi nyams myong dang go bstun nas shes par bya dgos so/ /'on kyang rtse gcig tshogs sbyor spros bral mthong lam ro gcig nas sgom med 'bring po'i bar sgom lam sgom med chen po sangs rgyas kyi sar 'jog pa shas che ste/ zhang rin po ches kyang*/ rtogs pa lhag gi shar ba de/ /mthong lam rab tu dga' ba'i sa// ro snyoms rtogs pa de nyid la/ /goms par byed pa sgom pa'i lam// sgom du med nas mthar phyin lam/ /zhes dang*/ rgod tshang pa'i re mig ma las/ lam lnga sa bcu'i gnas tshod rtse gcig tshogs lam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis sbyor lam nges 'byed cha bzhi spros bral mthong lam byang chub kyi yan lag bdun sa dang po rab tu dga' ba thob/ ro gcig sgom lam 'phags lam yan lag brgyad pa sa dgu pa thob pa'o/

/sgom med mthar phyin lam sa bcu gcig kun tu 'od gnon pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ grub thob gling gis kyang*/ dang po rtse gcig sbyor ba'i lam/ /nges shes cung zad skyes pa drod// de nyid 'phel bas rtse mo ste/ /sems med mi skrag bzod pa yin// rtse gcig 'jig rten chos kyi mchog /spros dang bral ba mthong ba'i lam// du ma ro gcig sa bcu'i rtogs pa 'char/ /sgom med bcu gcig mthar phyin lam// zhes dang*/ rgya ras kyis/ sa sogs lam la dgos med kyang*/ /'on kyang bstan na 'di ltar 'dod// maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba tshogs kyi lam/ /nyams myong skyes pa sbyor ba'i lam// rtogs pa skyes pa sgom pa'i lam/ /ro gcig pa ni sa brgyad pa// sgom med bcu gcig mthar phyin lam// zhes sogs mang du 'byung bas so/ /rnal 'byor bzhi po 'di'i ngo bo dang mnyam gzhag rjes shes rjes snang rjes thob rnams kyi rim pa spang bya dang rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs ngo bo mthong ma mthong sogs kyi rnam gzhag bogs 'don gegs sel rnal 'byor bzhi'i khyad par che 'bring chung gsum du 'jog pa sgrib pa gnyis spong tshul sa dang lam bgrod lugs sogs rgyas par khrid yig rnying pa khungs btsun rnams las 'byung bas 'dir ma bkod kyang de dag tu blta zhing blang dor tshul bzhin du byos shig

rnal 'byor pa zhig gi nyams thog tu dril na/ sems gsal la mi rtog pa sing nge ye re ba de las gzhan du mi 'phro ba'am zhi lhag zung du 'brel ba'i rgyun la rtse gcig tu gnas pa de rtse gcig /sems kyis sems nyid skye med du gsal sing gi shar ba de'i rang ngos nas 'khor gsum gyi spros pa dang bral ba spros bral/ snang ba sna tshogs su snang yang rang gi sems nyid du ro gcig cing bdag gzhan 'khor 'das sogs gnyis chos thams cad ro gcig tu gyur pa ro gcig /yin min phan tshun gang du bltas kyang rang gi sems nyid de'ang bsgom bya sgom byed la sogs pa gang du'ang ma grub par 'od gsal du cham cham 'char ba sgom med kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o// de yang rang rgyud la brtags te kho bo cag gi da lta'i dge sbyor 'di rtse gcig gi skabs su 'dug gam gang du 'dug brtags te rtse gcig gi'ang chung 'bring sogs gang du 'dug brtags te 'og mar 'dug na rim gyis gong ma gong mar na 'phar zhing 'jug pa'i thabs la rtsol bas 'bad par bya'o/ /nyams rtogs gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo zhen log nges 'byung byams snying rje dang khyad par kha zhe med par bla ma la sangs rgyas su nges pas dus rtag tu gsol ba btab pa'i mthu kho na las 'byung bas de ltar shes par byas nas gsol 'debs la nan tan du bya zhing gzhan yang na 'phar zhing gegs sel thabs dmigs pa dang spros bcas kyi thabs sogs la'ang shugs 'byung gis 'bad dgos so// 'di dag la lam bgrod tshul rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis skye tshul sogs snying por dril te lung rgyab sogs kyi spros pa bskyungs te bstan pa lags so/ /zhib tu bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung dang yig cha gzhan du gsal zhing rtogs ldan gyi bla ma'i thugs rgyud la ji ltar mnga' ba skal ldan gyi slob bu la ston par 'gyur ba rnams la tshul bzhin du slob par bya dgos so/

/rgyas par rnal 'byor bzhi po'i chung 'bring chen po re re la thun re byas kyang chog pas/ chos thun gya dgu pa'o/ /bsdu na rnal 'byor bzhi phyogs gcig bsdoms nas 'dir thun gcig byas kyang chog/ bzhi pa 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul ni/ de ltar rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis tshul bzhin rgyud la skyes te sgom med mthar phyin pa las rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa yin la/ de la'ang dbyings dang ye shes ro mnyam pa gzhi'i don la zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa mchog bsgrubs pas 'bras bu chos kyi sku dang gzugs kyi sku gnyis mngon du byed de/ chos sku ni lhag mthong ngo bo rtogs pa'am rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin mthar son pa'i 'bras bu dang gzugs sku ni sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs mngon du byas pa las sam/ ji snyed mkhyen pa'i shes rab kyi cha las byung ba yin la de'ang spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ni chos sku dag ma dag gang 'dul gyi tshul gyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa gzugs sku ste 'di las sku gsum dang bzhi la sogs pa dbyer rung ba'o// des na rang don chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis kyis sems can gyi don mdzad cing de'ang phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don rgya chen kun khyab mtha' gru rgyas par 'byung ngo*/ /der ma zad byed pa po la yod pa'i phrin las kyis rang don mthar thug rdzogs/ bya ba yul la yod pa'i phrin las kyis 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du sems can gyi don rgyun chad med par mdzad nas gang zag gi dbang po'i rim pa dang bstun nas rim gyis lam la khrid de gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can 'di nyid tshe gcig lus gcig stan thog gcig tu mngon du 'gyur ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa 'di nyid bstan pas gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'bad med du bskrun te phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes rgyud la skyes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byas te phrin las rgya chen po'i sgo nas 'gro ba thams cad smin grol gyi lam la 'god nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro/

/sku dang phrin las kyi rnam bzhag zhib tu sngar gyi yig cha rnams dang zur du gsal ba rnams las 'byung bas 'dir ma bkod/ de dag gis ni sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi sgo nas phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid dang nyams su blang bya'i rim pa rnams kyi dmigs rim legs par grub pa yin no/ /chos thun dgu bcu pa'o// 'dir 'phros don cung zad bshad na/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes pa'i don 'chad pa la/ ngo bo ngos gzung ba/ dbye ba/ mtshan gyi sgra bshad/ phyag rgya chen po dang lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khyad par/ nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ spyir phyag rgya chen po dang dbu ma chen po dang rdzogs pa chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sogs ming gi 'dogs tshul la du ma yod kyang ngo bo la dbyer med la phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo ni brjod pa dang ngos gzung thams cad dang bral la/ de lta na'ang mdzub mos zla ba mtshon pa ltar tshig gi sgo nas brjod pas dngos don gtan la 'bebs par nus te/ thabs kun rdzob la brten nas shes rab don dam rtogs nus pa bzhin no/ /de skad du'ang*/ kun rdzob la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so// des na phyag rgya chen po ni/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzhi gdod ma nas lhun gyis grub pa/ dpyad pa las byung ba ma yin zhing smra bsam gyi yul las 'das pa yod med stong mi stong sogs mu bzhi las grol zhing mtha' thams cad dang re dogs kun dang bral ba dus thams cad du 'pho 'gyur dang bzang ngan med pa kun khyab kun las 'das pa yod ma myong med ma myong snang stong rtag chad 'khrul grol thams cad dang bral ba sangs rgyas kyis ma mdzad sems can gyis ma bcos rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral/ mdog ma bsgyur/ gzugs ma 'dres/ sgom rang babs/

skyon rang dag /yon tan yongs rdzogs/ mtha' ye bral/ sku gsum rang chas/ spangs rtogs phun tshogs/ mkhyen pa gnyis ldan du lam me/ dngos po gshis ji ltar gnas pa'i gnas lugs/ 'khor 'das gnyis su rgyab ma gyes blo yis byar ma btub/ tha snyad kyi gdags sa ma rnyed snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang ba cir yang snang la gang du'ang ma grub pa snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab pa gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rgyun chad med cing chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu gsal stong spros bral bde stong dbye ba med par rnam pa kun gyis mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid ye gdod ma'i gnas lugs chos thams cad kyi dbyings dam par gyur pa de la phyag rgya chen po zhes bya/ 'di dag ston byed kyi lung ni bka' sde snod rgyud sde bla ma'i man ngag rnams las mang du 'byung yang yi ges 'jigs pas ma bris so// 'o na de 'dra'i phyag rgya chen po de ha mi go bas nyams su blang du'ang mi btub pas de'i snying po ngo ti mdzug gu 'dzugs sa med dam zhe na/ de ni snying por dril na rang gi sems mi dran dgu dran rig rig tur tur po gzhan gyis blo kha ma bsgyur ba thog ma'i sems tha mal gyi shes pa zhes bya ba 'di kho na yin gyi de las gzhan du btsal du med do/ /de skad du'ang*/ dwags po rin po ches/ tha mal pa'i shes pa 'di nyid gnyis med kyi ye shes don dam pa ma bcos pa sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin gyi logs nas mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i yon tan ci yang sgom du med/ ces dang*/ yang na sla ba yin te gzhan nas btsal mi dgos par rang la yod de nga'i sems nga'i sems zer ba 'di yin mtshan nyid sna tshogs la blta ba min ngo bo ma bcos pa rang gsal tsam du sing nge ye re ba 'di rang yin/ zhes dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ chos sku phyag rgya chen po zer ba'i sgra bo che de rang gi sems la zer ba yin/

sems ngo ma shes na nga'i sems nga'i sems zer ba'i mi dran dgu dran pa'i rig rig po 'di rang yin/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyang 'di rang las ma 'das*/ bka' sde snod rgyud sde thams cad kyi bcud kyang 'di rang yin/ zhes dang*/ rgod tshang pas/ 'o na ji ltar yin gyis dang da ltar gyi tha mal gyi shes pa dngos 'dzin dang stong 'dzin ye bral du 'dug pa 'di la phyag rgya chen por mdzug gu 'dzugs pa yin te/ 'di la 'char sgo dpag tu med pa zhig yod kyang gnyug ma ma bcos pa'i shes pa gcig pu 'di ka'i 'gros las med/ ces sogs dang*/ au rgyan pas/ de'ang da ltar gyi sems nyid 'di ka las sangs rgyas bya ba'i bzang po gzhan nas btsal du med de/ sems kyi gnas lugs ye gdod ma nas chos kyi sku ru lhun gyis grub par bzhugs pa yin/ zhes dang*/ sam+bu ṭi las/ phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ /'di dag thams cad sems kyis btags/ /sems las ma gtogs pa nyid ni/ gzhan du yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ phyag rgya chen po zhes pa la/ 'ga' zhig phyag snang ba/ rgya stong pa/ chen po zung du 'jug pa la zer te/ de chos kyi phyag rgya'i skad yin/ phyag rgya chen po'i skad min/ gsal stong gi skad thams cad dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i skad yin/ bde stong gi skad thams cad las kyi phyag rgya'i skad yin/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i bzhed pa'i rkyen gsum dang bral ba/ dga' ba bzhi las 'das pa/ 'od gsal las khyad par du gyur pa bya ba zhig bzhed pas na/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ bde ba'i rkyen la mi ltos/ gsal ba'i rkyen la mi ltos/ mi rtog pa'i rkyen la mi ltos pas rkyen gsum dang bral ba'o/ /zhes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po ni bla mas bstan du med/ slob mas go ru med pa/ nyams dang myong bas ma sbags pa dang*/ nges shes kyis ma bslad pa/ lta sgom spyod pas ma phye/

gzhi lam 'bras gsum du ma chad par 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos 'di la/ bsal bzhag gam/ bcings grol lam/ gnyen pos bcos gcig kyang ma byas par rang sar ngo shes shing rang grol ba la phyag rgya chen po zer ba lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ri khrod dbang phyug gis/ chos rnams thams cad rang gi sems yin te/ /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan rdul tsam med/ /ces sogs mtha' yas par gsungs so/ /chos thun go gcig pa'o// gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ dbye tshul brjod kyis mi lang yang*/ bsdu na gzhi phyag rgya chen po/ lam phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gong du bstan pa ltar gyi sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa 'phags pa'i gang zag gis rtogs shing mngon du bya rgyu khams gsum 'khor ba'i gshis kyi babs chos thams cad kyi gdod ma'i gnas lugs lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gzhi kun la khyab pa 'o skol sems can 'jag mig gi srin bu yan chad nas sangs rgyas mar bcad pa thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa bzang ngan dang che chung la sogs pa med pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag de yin/ gnas lugs chos sku'i bzhugs tshul de rtogs ma rtogs gnyis la 'khor 'das gnyis byung ba las rtogs pa'i dus na yang gzhi'i dus kyi chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba snang srid 'khor 'das kyi byed pa po 'di ka las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya de'i gong na chos sku zhes bzang po zhig btsal du med pas chen po zhes gdags su rung ba'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la de nyid yod cing de'ang snang stong rig stong bde stong dbyer med pa sku gsum ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du lhun gyis grub skye 'gag gnas gsum yod med spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar gnas kyang rang gi lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa'i dbang gis rang ngo ma shes te dper na mun pa'i nang du gzugs bstan pa bzhin no/

/gnas lugs de smra bsam shes brjod las 'das shing ngos gzung bral bas me dang nam mkha' la ri mo byed ma btub pa bzhin no/ /yul yul can rig bya rig byed dang bral bas ma shes te/ mig gis mig ma mthong ba bzhin no/ /de ston mkhan gyi bla ma med pas ma shes te/ rgyal bu dmangs su 'khyams pa bzhin no/ /dbyings gcig tu grub pas ma shes te/ sman ga pur dug tu song ba bzhin no/ /ngo bo rig par gnas pa des de ma thag log par rig nas phyin ci log tu btags pas ma shes te thag pa la sbrul du 'khrul ba bzhin no// des na kun brtags pa'i ma rig pas rang rig de nyid ngo ma shes pas nga med par nga bdag med par bdag spros pa med par spros pa chags sdang rmongs gsum sogs kyis kun nas bslangs te las bsags pa'i rnam smin so sor 'byung zhing 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ yang nye drags pas ngo ma shes pa'i skyon gyis rang la yod gtan du 'grogs kyang thag ma chod pa rang gi gdong bzhin du ma rig pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ sla drags pas yid ma ches te blo chung rnams sangs rgyas ni mtshan dpes brgyan pa'am chos kyi sku can yin pa la tha mal gyi shes pa 'di 'dra min don med snyam nas yid ma ches pas ma shes la/ zab drags pas ma shes te rtogs pa'i dra bas g.yengs te yengs med kyi dran pa dang bral bas ngos ma zin pa'i skyon gyis ma shes so/ /bzang drags nas ma shes te/ sems rang lugs su glod de de'i ngang nas ngos gzung med pa'i shes pa rang rig yul med du sa le ba 'di ka chos kyi sku yin kyang chos kyi sku de lta bu blor ma shong nas ma shes so/ /des na ma rig pa de dag spong bar byed dgos shing spong thabs la bla ma'i gdams ngag dang lam phyag rgya chen po dang nyams len gyi rim pa rnams la brtson pa bskyed pas sel lo/ /chos thun go gnyis pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ gzhi de ltar chos kyi sku ru ye gdod ma nas yod pa de mngon du byed pa'i thabs gong du bstan pa'i man ngag gi rim pa rnams dang de nyams su len par byed pa'i skabs kyi nyams myong mngon par rtogs pa dang bcas pa rnams yin cing*/

de'ang bla ma'i man ngag ltar nyams su blangs pas glo bur gyi dri ma phal cher dag nas rang nyid kyis kyang sems rang bzhin med par rtogs shing ngo shes nas de goms par byed pa yin la/ de rtogs par byed pa'i thabs la sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi sogs du ma gsungs kyang bka' brgyud rin po che 'di'i lugs la thams cad lam zab mo bla ma'i mos gus su 'dus par bzhed de/ rgod tshang pas/ 'dul ba'i sde snod thams cad lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab par 'dus la/ de yang mos gus su 'dus te/ bla ma la mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i dus su+u nyon mongs pa zhe sdang mi skye bar gda' bas zhe sdang gi gnyen por de song*/ de bzhin du nyon mongs pa kun la des 'gre/ zhes sogs dang*/ mdo sde'i sde snod thams cad lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab par 'dus la de yang zab mo mos gus kyi lam 'dir 'dus te/ chos kyi sku'i mos gus kyis bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres nas rang gi sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gag dang bral bar rtogs pa'i sa mā dhi de la nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gis mi phyed pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang ting nge 'dzin der ni ting nge 'dzin brgya 'du bar mgon po 'bri khung pa kun bzhed par 'dug /ces dang*/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyang lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab par 'dus/ de yang zab mo mos gus kyi lam 'dir 'dus te/ rje'i byin rlabs kyis mtho dman 'bring gsum bla ma chos skur shar/ lus snang sems gsum thams cad rang sems gnyug ma spros bral du ro gcig tu rtogs pas shes bya thams cad kyi sgro 'dogs sems thog tu chod cing dbang bsgyur bas te/ zhes dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi yang mos gus su 'dus te zhes pa nas/ lus longs spyod thams cad kyis bla ma mchod pas zhabs thog tu srog gtong zhing lus la lcags gzer stong btab kyang spro bar byed pa rje btsun mi la lta bu yin te/

'di bya ba'i rgyud kyi lag len yin/ zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa dang*/ de la rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa dang snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur sgrogs pa spyod pa'i rgyud yin te/ gnyis pa ngag spyod gtso bor ston/ /zhes gsungs/ mos gus kyi gdung ba rgyun chad med pa dang dran rtogs thams cad bla ma'i thugs su sgom zhing shar ba rnal 'byor rgyud de/ gsum pa sems tshor gtso bor ston/ /zhes gsungs/ rje btsun gyi byin rlabs kyis thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su shar na bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin te/ bzhi pa lhan skyes 'ba' zhig go /zhes gsungs/ zhes sogs dang*/ dbang bzhi rim gnyis rnams kyang mos gus kho na la tshang bar gsungs pa bzhin shes par bya'o//

gzhan yang sems nyid phyag rgya chen po dang snang srid phyag rgya chen po sogs su'ang dbyer yod pa las/ ye gdod ma'i gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mtha' thams cad dang bral bar rang gi rgyud la yod pa de la sems nyid phyag rgya chen po zhes bya la/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad ye shes kyi rba klong chen po gcig tu cham gyis rtogs pa'am shar ba de la snang srid phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o/ /de gnyis nyams su len tshul ni gong gi khrid rim rnams dang 'jog tshul thams cad yin no/ /chos thun go gsum pa'o// der ma zad lta ba/ sgom pa/ spyod pa gsum gyi sgo nas kyang nyams su blang rung ba las/ lta sgom spyod 'bras ni/ rje mi las/ lta ba yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la ltos// sems las gzhan du lta ba btsal ba na// gyad kyis nor 'tshol 'dra 'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// sgom pa yin par nges kyi bying rgod skyon ma sel// sgom pa bying rgod 'thor rmugs skyon sel na// nyin par mar me 'degs pa 'dra 'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// spyod pa yin par nges kyi blang dor res ma byed// spyod pa blang dor re dogs res byed na// sbrang bu rgyar chud 'dra 'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// 'bras bu yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la nges shes skyed// thob med 'bras bu gzhan nas btsal ba na// sbal pa gnam du mchongs pa 'dra 'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// zhes dang*/ yang na dwags po rin po ches gsungs pa ltar/ sems gsal la 'dzin med nam mkha' 'dra/ /phyogs su ma lhung lta ba yin// sems rang rig rang gsal me long 'dra/ /gsal 'grib med pa sgom pa yin// sems ma bcos lhug pa bu chung 'dra/ /dgag sgrub bral ba spyod pa yin// zhes dang*/ rang gi sems la lta ba lta ba yin/ /chos rnams sems su rtogs na rtogs pa yin// de la goms par byed na sgom pa yin/ /ngo bo nyams su myong na nyams myong yin//

de la rgyun du gnas pa spyod pa yin/ /ngo bo mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu yin// de nyid gzhan la ston pa phrin las yin/ /lta ba la brten rtogs pa 'char// sgom pa la brten nyams myong skye/ /'bras bu las gzhan don phrin las 'byung*// zhes dang*/ rgod tshang pas/ 'khor 'das gnyis su med par rtogs pa de lta ba yin/ tshogs drug gi snang ba sna tshogs su shar ba la bden 'dzin gyi blo dang bral ba de sgom pa yin/ bde sdug gang byung yang ro snyoms na spyod pa yin/ mnyam gzhag rjes thob med par gzung 'dzin nam mkha' ltar dag pa 'bras bu yin/ lta sgom spyod 'bras hril gyis dril na de bas med do/ /zhes dang*/ rje rin po che zhang gis/ bltas pas mthong ba med na lta ba de nyid yin// dran mthong dngos po med na sgom pa de nyid yin// bde stong gcig tu 'dres na nyams myong de nyid yin// snga phyi gnyis dang bral na spyod pa de nyid yin// re dogs spros pa chod na 'bras bu de nyid yin// bla ma'i man ngag yin gyi rgyud la thebs par zhu/ /zhes dang*/ lta ba phyogs ris med par gyis/ /spyod pa tshul 'chos med par gyis// snying rje phyogs cha med par gyis/ /sgom pa g.yeng ba med par gyis// yon tan zad pa med par 'byung*/ /zhes dang*/ lta ba phyin ci ma log cing*/ /gdams ngag snod tshod ma 'chugs dang*// sgom pa ma nor thong lhod med/ /spyod pa zhen med skyon ma gos// dam tshig lha yis ma khrel na/ /'bras bu dgos 'dod gdon mi za// dper na sman gyi sdong po bzhin/ /zhes dang*/ blta bya lta byed gnyis med pas/ /zhen med lta ba'i rgyal po yin// bsgom bya sgom byed zhen med pas/ /zhen med sgom pa'i rgyal po yin// spyad bya spyod byed zhen med pas/ /zhen med spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// thob bya thob byed zhen med pas/ /zhen med 'bras bu'i rgyal po yin// zhes dang*/ rje rang byung rdo rjes/

rang gi rig pa 'di la rang gis bltas na lta ba zer ba yin/ spyod rgyu med pa la spyod pa zer ba yin/ de ltar spyod pa la zung 'jug zer ba yin/ ma yengs par gnas pa de la sgom pa zer ba yin/ zhes dang*/ don la/ rang gi sems la blta na lta ba yin/ /de la ma yengs sgom pa yin// de dang ma bral spyod pa yin/ /de mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu yin// bltas pas blta rgyu med do snang ba sems nyid yin// bsgoms pas bsgom rgyu med do rig pa rang gsal yin// spyod pas spyod rgyu med do rang byung shugs la spyod// 'bras bu sgrub rgyu med do rang sems sangs rgyas yin// zhes dang*/ tai lo pas/ gzung 'dzin kun las 'das na lta ba'i rgyal po yin// yengs pa med na sgom pa'i rgyal po yin// bya rtsol med na spyod pa'i rgyal po yin// re dogs med na 'bras bu'i rgyal po yin/ /zhes dang*/ 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis/ sems nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log pa mthong ba lta ba/ de la rgyun du ma yengs pa sgom pa/ de nyid la spyod pas spyod pa/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad med na mi 'byung zhing rten 'brel 'ba' zhig yin/ rten 'brel thams cad skad cig mar gnas pa yin/ skad cig de'ang rten 'brel stong nyid yin pas 'bras bu chos kyi sku'o/ /zhes dang*/ bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung bzhin/ 'ba' ra bas gsal bar mdzad pa las/ cer gyis lta ba lta ba yin/ /de la ma yengs sgom pa yin// rgyun du spyod pas spyod pa yin/ /lta ba grub mtha' las grol ba// sgom pa sems 'dzin las grol ba/ /spyod pa blang dor las grol ba/ /zhes so// zhes gsungs pa ltar dang*/ rje phag grus/ spyir sgom byed pa'i rten gyi gang zag lta ba gdengs dang lan pa rgod po nam 'phang spyod pa lta bu zhig dgos/ sgom pa rgyun chad med pa mdzangs ma'i sris lta bu zhig dgos/ spyod pa shugs las byung ba glang rgan chu gtong ba lta bu zhig dgos/

de'ang dka' sla skyid sdug byung na lta ba brjed/ nad tshabs po che byung yang lta ba brjed/ rang nyid 'chi ba'i tshe na'ang lta ba brjed par byas nas khams bde sos dal/ nyi grib mtshams na 'bol gdan chen po'i khar bsdad nas skyems kyis bzi/ shas brgyags pa'i dus su lag pa gnam du bsgreng*/ nam shi sangs rgyas yin/ thod pa bor chog yin/ thams cad stong pa yin zer yang kha lta rkyang pa yin pas des kyang cung mi phan gsungs/ des na lta ba gdengs dang ldan pa zhig dgos te/ rang la dka' sla dang na tsha byung ba'i dus su lta ba'i gnas lugs dran nas zug dang sdug bsngal zhi nus pa zhig dgos/ de la'ang lta ba'i gnas lugs yod pas mi chog go dgos/ /rtogs dgos/ go ba dang rtogs par byed pa la bla ma dam pa zhig dang mjal nas mos gus rab dang ldan pas gdams ngag rin po che la brten dgos gsungs/ de la rgod nam mkhar 'phur ba'i dus su mjug sgro sa gzhi la gtad dgos/ 'phur zin nas gar sdod pa'i sar shes pa 'phen pas 'gro ba min pa 'dab ma g.yob pa la sogs pa mi dgos pa dang 'dra gsungs/ sgom pa rgyun chad med pa zhig dgos te/ bla ma'i rtsa dang mi sngun la sogs par tsab tsub mang po byed/ mnyam gzhag thun grangs mang po bgrang yang rjes kyi dus su nyon mongs pa dug gsum yang cung zhig mgo ma non/ /rnam par rtog pa shas cher song rgyud kyang rtsub tu song na tha mal pa dang khyad med/ des na mi sgom pa 'dra yang dus rtag tu rang gi sems la lta ba gal che/ nyon mongs pa chags sdang gi dbang du ma song bar bya zhing dkar po'i phyogs la dran pa yengs pa med par 'bad dgos/ de'ang pha rol du phyin pa'i dbang du byas na dran pa dang shes bzhin zer nas bslab pa gsum gyi rten nam rgyur bshad de/ dus rtag tu der 'gro na sgom pa rgyun chad med pa yin/ de'ang mdzangs ma'i sris zad pa dang 'dra na'ang dus rtag tu spyod rgyu spring nge ba zhig yod pa dang 'dra/

spyod pa shugs las byung ba zhig dgos te/ de la spyod pa rab bla ma la mos gus yin/ de'ang spyod pa zer nas pha gi na mar la mang po yod pa de lta bu cung min/ 'gro nyal 'dug sdod dang ci byed pa thams cad sems can gyi don du byed pa gal che/ spyod pa shugs 'byung zer nas ngan pa'i shugs 'byung du song na mi nag ldings por 'gro/ /dkon mchog gsum mchod pa la sogs pa dge ba'i phyogs la 'bad/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba thams cad chos su ci 'gro bya/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byas thams cad ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don du bsngo/ lkog tu khab tsam yang mi byed/ mi sngun na ni brtson 'grus zer nas maṇ+ḍal phyi ba dang phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa phag mjug 'dra na'ang brtson 'grus cung min pas dus rtag tu drag zhan med par 'bung dgos/ glang rgan chu gtong ba la dang po drag tu med/ phyis ma chad bar du zhan rgyu med pa dang 'dra ba zhig dgos/ zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs so// bsdu na gnas lugs kyi don la lta bas lta ba/ zhi lhag dbyer med rtse gcig gi don la 'jog pas sgom pa/ spyod pa bzhi'i sgo nas dge sbyor la bogs 'don pa ni spyod pa gnas lugs mthar thug mngon du byas te re dogs dang gzung 'dzin thams cad dang bral zhing sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob nas phrin las bzhis gdul bya thams cad skyong bar byed pa 'bras bu yin cing de dag gi don lta sgom gnyis ni khrid yongs rdzogs 'di ka'i khog tu rgyas par yod do// spyod pa la'ang kun tu bzang po/ gsang spyod/ rig pa brtul zhugs/ tshogs spyod/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ lhag mthong gi nyams dang ma bral ba spyod lam rnam bzhir rnam rtog thams cad rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa ltar gnyen po bsten mi dgos par chos nyid kyi ngang du lhan gyis zhi rang yal du 'gro ba'o/ /de bogs 'don par gsang spyod bya ste dur khrod dam shing gcig la sogs pa'i gnas su phyag rgya mo dang ldan par bya ba'o/

/rig pa brtul zhugs ni/ lus gcer bur byas rgyan drug gis brgyan phyag rgya mo dang lhan cig grong du rgyu ba'o/ tshogs spyod ni/ khrom chen po'am tshong 'dus sam rigs ngan gyi khyim sogs su phyin te glu gar la sogs pas bstod rgod gshe rdeg 'tshog sogs byung na nags la me mched pa ltar dge sbyor dang ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gro ba'o/ /de grogs su song na phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa bya ste ma rig pa sangs/ dug zos pas kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur bas zas las rgyal/ zag bcas kyi rlung 'gags pas rlung las rgyal/ 'khor 'das thams cad la phyogs ris med pas phyogs las rnam par rgyal/ blang dor med pas spyod pa mthar phyin pa de ni spyod pa lnga'o/ /de thams cad kyi dus na'ang ye nas yod pa'i chos nyid stong pa de'i mdangs las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/ de'i gong na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zhes pa btsal du med pas chen po zhes bya'o/ /de dag ni lam phyag rgya chen po'i rim pa'o/ /chos thun go bzhi pa'o// gsum pa 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ni/ lam gyi rim pa rnams bgrod pas gzhi'i nyes pa zad de mngon du gyur/ lam gyi nyes pa zad de mthar phyin/ gzhi thog tu 'bras bu sleb/ chos can gyi dngos po thams cad la ma 'gags par snang bzhin du rang gi ngo bos stong*/ stong pa'i bzhugs tshul de nyid las chos can ji snyed cig snang ba thams cad kyang de las logs su ma grub cing gnyis su med pas gnyis 'dzin dang re dogs kyi 'khor ba las grol/ rtogs pa mthar phyin te stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i don rtogs shing sku gsum ye shes lnga yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i bdag nyid can sgom med mthar thug rtogs shing sgrib pa mtha' dag las grol rtogs bya thams cad rtogs bral ba dang rnam par smin pa sogs kyi yon tan ma lus pa mngon du byas pa de la 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po zhes bya/

spyir phyi nang gi chos thams cad snang rig stong gsum las ma 'das pas sku gsum gyi ngo bo yin/ de dag gzhi lam 'bras gsum dang sbyar na gzhi'i sku gsum ni rang sems cir yang ma grub pa spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de'i dbyings stong par 'char ba chos sku/ de'ang stong pa cang med dam bem po lta bu ma yin par stong pa rang rig rang gsal rang bzhin sna tshogs su rig pas longs sku/ stong nyid de mdangs ma 'gags par rang gzugs yul sna tshogs su shar ba sprul sku yin/ sku gsum rang la tshang ba'i dpe til la snum gyis khyab pa dang baiḍūr+ya lta bu dang ma bcos gnyug ma rnams rim bzhin sbyar ro// yang rang byung bas gsungs pa ltar na/ ngo bo stong pa chos sku/ rang bzhin gsal ba longs sku/ ma 'gags shing cir yang snang ba sprul sku yin/ stong pa de chos dbyings ye shes/ gsal ba de me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de gnyis mnyam por gnas pa de mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis ma 'dres par so sor gnas pa de so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de rnams ma bcos par lhun gyis grub pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes yin/ gong gi stong pa de sku yin/ gsal le ba de gsung*/ de gnyis su med par mnyam por gnas pa de thugs yin/ zhes gsungs so// gzhan yang gzhi lam 'bras gsum gtso bor ston pa la de dang de'i phyag chen dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las gtso bor ston pa bde stong phyag chen/ thabs rgyud las gtso bor ston pa gsal stong phyag chen/ gnyis med rgyud las gtso bor ston pa rig stong phyag chen/ zhes dang*/ yang rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs la dgongs nas gnas lugs phyag chen/ de rtogs byed bde stong zung 'jug gis rtogs pa la dgongs nas bde stong phyag chen dang gnyis su dbye ba'am/ yang gnas lugs de nyid la dgongs te rang bzhin lhan skyes/ de mtshon byed dpe'i sgo nas rtogs par byed pa'i dbang gsum pa'i lam rim zhu bde lhan skyes/

don de mngon sum du rtogs pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam bde stong lhan skyes te lhan skyes gsum du dbye bar mdzad pa las phyi ma la phyag rgya chen po zhes bya/ der ma zad dper na dngul rdo dang de las phye ba'i dngul dang dngul de las sku 'dra la sogs bzos pa dang gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi phyag rgya chen po 'dra'o/ /dam tshig kyang*/ zhang rin po ches/ phyag rgya chen po'i dam tshig ni bzhi ste/ nyon mongs pa spang du med de rang gi sems yin pas so/ /gnyen po ye shes rgyud la bsten du med de de dang gnyis su med pas so/ /de kho na nyid sgom du med de dmigs su med pas so/ /'bras bu la re ba med de rang gi sems nyid rtogs pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'di dag ni dbye ba'o/ /chos thun go lnga pa'o// gsum pa mtshan gyi sgra bshad ni/ phyag chen thig le las/ phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes te/ /rgya ni 'khor ba'i chos las grol// chen po zung du 'jug pa ste/ /phyag rgya chen po zhes brjod do/ /zhes dang*/ yi ge bzhi par/ phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes te/ /rgya ni phyogs ris med pa yin// chen po mtha' las 'das pa ste/ /des na yi ge 'bru bzhir grags/ /zhes dang*/
