sgom ma mo chen mo las/ phyag ni bde stong dbyer med de/ /mi 'da'i phyir na rgya nyid yin/ /zhes dang*/ dwags po rin po ches/ de la phyag ni snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang las mi 'da' bar rtogs pa ni phyag go /spyir snang srid thams cad gnyug ma'i don las mi 'da' bas rgya'o/ /chos nyid rang grol du rtogs pas chen po'o/ /zhes dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba ni mi 'da' ba'i don gyis na phyag rgya yin/ yangs shing rgya che bas chen po zhes bya'o/ /dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i bka' btags kyi phyag rgya gang yin pa de la mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal phran la sogs pa gang gis kyang 'da' bar mi srid pa de bzhin du phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa'i ngang las kyang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos gang gis kyang 'da' bar mi srid de/ de dag gi rang bzhin nyid phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa de yin pa'i phyir yangs shing rgya che bas na chen po zhes bya/ zhes dang*/ au rgyan pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi byed pa po 'di ka las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya de'i gong na chos sku zhes pa'i bzang ba zhig btsal du med pas chen po zhes dang*/ dpal mkha' spyod pas/ phyag gi don ni dbyings dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa'o/ /'khor ba rang sar grol ba ni rgya'i don no/ /de ltar zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes bla na med pa ni chen po ste/ zhes dang*/ rgyal ba mi bskyod zhabs kyis/ de yang phyag rgya ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya ste/ dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bka' btags kyi phyag rgya la rgyal phran dang blon po rnams kyis mi 'da' ba bzhin no/ /chen po ni/ las chos dam tshig las 'das pa'am 'di las dbang che ba med pas chen po'o/ /zhes dang*/ bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung las kyang*/ phyag ni zhe sa'i don te rgyal ba rnams kyi phyag go

/rgya ni zung du 'jug cing de las mi 'da' ba'i don no/ /chen po zhes pa ni phyag rgya gzhan thams cad gnas skabs pa yin pas 'da' ba yod cing 'di ni mthar thug yin pas sus kyang 'da' ba med pas mchog tu gyur pa'i don no/ /zhes sogs mdo rgyud man ngag du ma nas gsungs pa ltar ro// lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes pa/ mkha' spyod pas/ lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa de brjod bya// rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa nyid/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig/ ces lhan cig gi don dang*/ skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid nas rang bzhin med/ /ces skyes pa'i don dang sbyor ba ni rnal 'byor gyi don te/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi tshul min zhing*/ /shes rab gcig pu nyid kyis min/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnal 'byor gsungs/ /zhes sbyor ba'i don te de ltar phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi don gyi ngo bo mdor bsdus te bstan pa 'di tsam gyis kyang dbang po rab skal pa mchog dang ldan pa grol bar byed de yan lag gi don mang po la ltos pa med do/ /zhes dang*/ dwags po rin po ches/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ni gang dang gang skyes sbyor zhe na/ rig pa dang stong pa lhan cig tu skyes/ de rang yang tha dad 'dug pa lta bu ma yin te/ rig pa/ gsal ba/ bde ba stong pa nyid du sbyor bas na lhan cig skyes sbyor ro/ /zhes dang*/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gis/ nges tshig ni/ phyag ces pa stong pa yin la/ rgya zhes pa mi 'da' ba la 'jug pas na 'di ltar snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad ma bcos ma bsgyur ma bslad so ma nyams gra ma chag par gang snang gang shar thams cad kyi rang gshis sam gnas lugs cir yang ma grub pa'i stong par 'dug pas na phyag ste/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud las/ e ma sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang*/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba med//

skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid nas skye ba med/ /ces so// gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba ngan pa dang bzang po sna tshogs pa ji snyed cig shar yang*/ stong pa nyid las mi 'da' ba'i phyir rgya ste dper na nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba'am phyi'i rgya mtsho la nya ji tsam zhig 'phyo yang nam mkha' dang chu las mi 'da' ba bzhin no/ /dpal gsang ba spyod pa'i rgyud las/ chos kun sems kyi ngo bo ste/ /sems ni stong pa'i ngo bo yin// thams cad stong par ro gcig pas/ /'di ni blang dor med pa'i dbyings// zhes so/ /des na gang dang gang shar yang stong pa nyid las mi 'da' bas na spang bya 'khor ba'i chos kyi rgya las ye nas grol ba ste spang bya rang bzhin med pas 'ching byed kyi rgya med/ /nga bdag la rang bzhin med pas 'ching bya'i bdag med/ 'ching bya 'ching byed med pas 'khor ba'i chos las grol ba'o/ /gang snang ba'i thog na snang ba'i rang bzhin cir yang ma grub pas stong pa/ stong pa'i gdangs gsal la ma 'gags par rjen ne ba snang ba/ gang shar gyi thog tu sus kyang bzo ma byas par zung 'jug tu khrig ge ba'i gong na gzhan med pas chen po ste/ me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan gyi rnam pa snang yang de'i rang bzhin med pas stong pa/ de la de'i rang bzhin mi 'dug kyang de'i rnam pa gsal bar snang ba'o/ /de skad du phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ nyon cig lha mo phyag rgya che/ /phyag rgya chen po gsang ba che// brjod med mi zad ma skyes pa/ /thams cad gzugs can gzugs dang bral// gzugs med gzugs kyi bdag po mchog /sbom phra la sogs dang bral ba// gzhal du med pa'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes dang*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ni/ gnyis lhan cig tu tshogs pa lta bu la lhan cig skyes par mi 'dod de/ dngos po ngo bo gcig la chos gsum ldan lhan cig skyes pa lta bu zhig yin te/

gser gyi ngo bo gcig la kha dog ser ba/ lcid che ba/ bzhu btul byas pas ngan du mi 'gro ba gsum tshang la/ de'i ser po las gzhan pa'i lcid che ba dang bzhu btul byas pas mi 'gyur ba logs na med la/ lcid che ba las logs su gzhan gnyis po med de/ de gsum ga gser ma yin na ma gtogs gser yin phan chad lhan cig skyes pas ser po'i steng du kha dog ser ba/ lcid che ba/ bzhu btul byas pas ngan du mi 'gro ba gsum tshang la/ de bzhin du gzhan gnyis po'i steng du gsum gsum tshang ba bzhin du gzhi byang chub kyi sems 'di la'ang ngo bo rig pa/ rang bzhin stong pa/ mtshan nyid gsal ba gsum lhan cig skyes la/ de'i stong pa las gzhan pa'i logs su rig pa dang gsal ba med la/ gsal ba las gzhan pa'i logs su stong pa dang rig pa med/ rig pa las gzhan pa'i logs su gsal ba dang stong pa med/ ngo bo sems gcig pu yin pa la ldog chos la stong pa rig pa gsal ba gsum byung ba'o/ /gsum byung yang de gsum ga dbyer med par lhan cig skyes pa ste/ stong pa nyid rig pa dang gsal bar skyes/ rig pa nyid stong pa dang gsal bar skyes/ gsal ba nyid stong pa dang rig par skyes pas gsal rig stong gsum po re re'i steng na gsum ga tshang bar skyes pas lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya'o/ /de skad du'ang brtag gnyis las/ lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom par gcig /ces so/ /de rgyud la sbyor ba de la lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes bya'o/ /de lta bu ya gi sangs rgyas nas ma gi 'jag mig gi srin bu yan chad la bzang ngan nam che chung med par gnas so/ /de rang ngo nam shes pa'i tshe lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o/ /de ngo ma shes pa'i dus na kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhes bya'o/ /de ngo shes pa dang ma shes pa gnyis la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya'o/

/de gnyis gang snga na dus la snga phyi med do/ /ngo bo la bzang ngan med de/ de gnyis ka ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ de la phyag rgya chen po'i sgra don ni/ phyag rgya chen po la saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du ma hā mu drā'i sgra las drangs pa mi 'da' ba'am mi phyed pa'am mi stong pa la 'jug ste/ de'ang snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sa rang sa nas so ma nyams mdog ma bsgyur bar dus gsum dus med du lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/ de las logs pa'am de'i gong na gzhan med pas na chen po'o/ /de'ang shes pa skad cig ma'i thog tu phyogs gcig tu sbyar na rnam par rtog pa zhig thol te skyes pa'i dus su rnam rtog de la dgag sgrub gcig kyang ma byas par rnam rtog ta le ba de rang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos gzhir 'dug la/ de rtogs rung ma rtogs rung de las mi 'da' bas phyag rgya/ rnam rtog de las logs na ye shes sam sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zhes btsal du med pas chen po'o/ /zhes dang*/ 'di dag ni phyag rgya chen po dang lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi mtshan gyi sgra bshad yin cing*/ der ma zad phyag rgya chen po dang dbu ma chen po rdzogs pa chen po sogs ji ltar btags kyang 'gal ba med de/ phag grus/ rnam rtog dang ni nyon mongs pa/ /thams cad 'dul bas 'dul ba yin/ /rnam par rtog pa chos sku ru/ /nges pa'i shes pa skyed pa'i sa/ /sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod pas na/ /'di ni bla ma'i gdams ngag yin/ /rtag chad sgro skur la sogs pa'i/ /mtha' dang bral bas dbu ma yin/ /smra bsam brjod du med pa'i phyir/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos/ /sems su rdzogs pas rdzogs chen yin/ /bzang rtog ngan rtog thams cad kun/ /yid la mi byed phyag rgya che/ /sdug bsngal zhi bas zhi byed yin/

/nyon mongs dang ni rnam rtog kun/ /lam du slongs pas gsang sngags yin/ /sems dang rnam rtog chos sku gsum/ /dang po lhan cig skyes pas te/ /gdams pas gcig tu sbyor ba'i phyir/ /lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes su bshad/ /'dre dang bdud la sogs pa yi/ /bar gcod la yang bsngags so gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos thun go drug pa'o// bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po dang lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khyad par ni/ dwags po rin po ches/ phag gru la dris lan gnang bar/ phyag rgya chen po dang lhan cig skyes sbyor gnyis la khyad par bdog gam mi bdog zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po ni/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad ye nas lhun gyis grub pa chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu dus thams cad pa'i ye shes gnyis med cig yin/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ni/ rtog pa gang skyes sku bzhir sbyor ba yin pas dus thams cad par mi 'dod de rgyun chad yod/ ces dang*/ zhang rin po ches/ de lta bu yi ngo bo de/ tshig dang brtag dpyad kyis mi mthong*// tha mas brgyud pa'i lam la 'bad/ /'bring gis rtsa rlung thabs la 'bad// rab kyis lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor ye shes kyis/ /rnam rtog gzhigs nas chos skur bkyer// phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag ni/ /rnam rtog glod nas chos skur bkyer// zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs so// mdor na phyag rgya chen po ni/ don bzhi'i sgo nas ston la der brjod don mtha' dag 'dus shing*/ de'ang rgod tshang pa'i gsung las byung ba ltar brjod na/ rgod tshang pas/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba ni/ ngo bo/ nges tshig /dbye ba/ khyad par dang bzhi/ ngo bo ni des thams cad la khyab pa thams cad de'i rang bzhin du 'dus pa bsam brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'o/ /nges tshig /phyag ni stong pa nyid yin te/ /rgya ni 'khor ba'i chos las grol/

/chen po zung 'jug rtogs pa yin/ /zhes so/ dbye ba la gsum ste/ gzhi kun la khyab pa'i phyag rgya chen po/ lam nyams su len pa'i phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu lhun gyis grub pa'i phyag rgya chen po/ phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid gsum ldan ni/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa/ rnam pa cir yang mi 'gag pa/ de nyid dbyer med du gnas pa'o/ /khyad par yang lnga ste/ lta ba lung rigs la ma ltos par rtogs pa nang nas shar ba'i khyad par/ sgom pa sems 'dzin la ma ltos par bying rgod rang sar grol ba'i khyad par/ dam tshig bsrung sdom la ma ltos par zag med kyi sdom pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i khyad par/ spyod lam gnyen po la ma ltos par blang dor mdud pa rang sar grol ba'i khyad par/ 'bras bu dus rtags la ma ltos par lhun grub rang chas su gnas pa'i khyad par ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /chos thun go bdun pa'o// lnga pa nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu ji ltar 'byung ba ni/ gong gi 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul dang mthun pa zhi gnas lhag mthong dbyer med kyi nyams rtogs rgyud la skye ba dang*/ rtse gcig spros bral ro gcig sgom med la sogs pa'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur cing sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams cig car ram rim gyis bgrod de rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dam pa mngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ /'dir bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung rnams nges shes 'drongs phyir dang byin rlabs che bar bsams tshig tshogs la ma 'dzems par sgra drang thad du lung drangs pa yin la/ nyams len skyong ba po rnams kyis kyang tshig ris zin na byin rlabs che bas gzung chog la tshig ris gal te ma zin kyang de'i don rnams gsal btab nas rgyud la ci 'drer bsgoms pas don 'grub bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gcig shes kun grol gyi man ngag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa brgyud pa gzhan dang tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa rtogs ldan gyi bla ma thams cad kyi thugs kyi bcud bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad kyis nyams su bzhes shing thugs rgyud la skyes pa des 'gro ba thams cad smin grol du 'god par mdzad pa theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse gdams ngag thams cad kyi snying po phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig gi snying po mchog tu gyur pa bltas pa tsam gyis shes shing nyams rtogs rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ba nges don rgya mtsho'i snying po phrin las 'od 'phro thar 'dod dga' ston 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas rnam grol mchog sbyin zhes bya ba 'di ni/

rang bzo'i lhad spangs te bla ma gong ma sgam po pa dang dus mkhyen sogs nas bzung ste/ dpal ldan bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog yan lag gi bar du byon pa'i bka' brgyud kyi bla ma tshad ldan rnams kyi gsung rgyun rnams las ma g.yos par sgra ji bzhin du bsdus te phan pa'i sems kyis chos sbyin du byas pa'o/ /'on kyang rang bzo dang lhag chad byung tshe bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang yod des sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de nyid gegs med du skye bar gyur cig smras pa/ bdag ni thos chung nyams len gyis dben zhing*/ /nam 'chi cha med tsam la'ang 'phrig ma tshud/ /tshe 'di'i g.yeng ba 'ur sgrob kyis khyer nas/ /nyams myong thams cad yid smon tsam du bas/ /de phyir rang myong steng nas brjod dka' yang*/ /bka' brgyud rin chen 'di la nus mchis pas/ /de la yid ches mos pa skyes pa'i mthus/ /nges don snying po cung zad bkod pa yin/ /'di na deng sang sangs rgyas bstan pa yang*/ /lnga brgya tha mar gyur du nye ba nas/ /rab byung phal cher khyim pa'i bya bas g.yengs/ /thos bsam sgom gsum rgyab tu lings kyis bor/ /nyin mtshan dge la bkol ba smos ci dgos/ /dgra 'dul gnyen skyong pher sha stong sgrob dang*/ /ltau phyir gnam rdib gral phyir bsnyen rdzogs dang*/ /zang zing phyir du tshul 'chos slob gnyer byed/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod nga rgyal ser snas bklubs/ /brtags na rang rgyud nyon mongs kyis gang yang*/ /grub thob mkhas btsun 'gran zla med snyam bgyid/ /rang la ltos bcas sdig la sbyor ba mang*/ /bla ma'i gsung rnams lkog na mor byas nas/ /rang gis rtogs shing shes par khas ches te/ /gzhan la 'chad cing 'dren par bcos pa

yi/ /rang mgo rang gis g.yogs pa du ma snang*/ /de yang bdag gis 'di ltar sbyar ba ni/ /mkhas rlom rgyang bsrings ma rgan sems can ched/ /rang bzo'i bslad spangs bka' brgyud gsung bzhin du/ /ma sbas drang po'i tshul gyis smras pa yin/ /'on kyang lhag chad 'gal 'khrul gang mchis pa/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /dge ba gang mchis mkha' khyab sems can rnams/ /gnas lugs mchog gi rang zhal mthong gyur cig /zab don snying po legs bshad bdud rtsi 'di/ /thar 'dod don gnyer re ba bskang phyir du/ /rang blor gang shar gsal bar bstan pa'i mthus/ /'gro kun 'chi med rdo rje'i sa thob shog /nges don snying po phrin las 'od 'phro 'di/ /mthong thos dran dang nyams su sus blangs pa/ /nyams rtogs dbyar gyi chu bo ltar phyur zhing*/ /'bad med grol te phrin las kun 'grub shog /de ltar phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi/ /nyams len khrid rim zab dgu'i snying po 'di/ /sku skye karma grags pa rnam rgyal ba/ /sogs kyis g.yar nan ji bzhin bkod pa'i dges/ /kun kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi/ /snang ba cher rgyas bstan pa'i pad tshal che/ /phyogs brgyar rab bzhad lhar bcas skye dgu rnams/ /zung 'jug bde chen go 'phang myur thob shog/ ces pa 'di lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan du mas 'byor pa sngon sbyangs dang ldan zhing skye ba'i phreng ba can dpal ri po che pa pad+ma rgyal po'i sprul sku sku skye karma grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang po sogs mos pa dang rnam dpyod ldan pa 'ga' zung gis bskul bar g.yar khral du phyogs bcu pa dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug gis gdan sa chen po mtshur phu nas mgo brtsams/ 'bri khung bkra shis tshal du dmigs thun dang ltag bstun reg zig tu byas pa'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar sgrub rgyud bstan pa rab rgyas mkha' khyab 'gro kun bde dge'i dpal la spyod pa'i rgyan du shog

/chos thun go brgyad pa'o/ /dmigs pa bzhi bcu zhe lnga yod cing*/ rjes kyi skabs su'ang skabs thob dang bstun pa'i dmigs pa bsgom yang sgom rgyu ni ji ltar rigs pa yod/ /'di'i dmigs pa rnams nyams su blang bya dang chos thun rnams go byar shes par bya'o// chos 'di'i bka' srung dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ber nag po can lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pas mdzod la/ mi mos pa dang skal med dang*/ yi ge tsam la brten nas rgyud la skyes kha ba'i sgo nas mi chos bla ma'i rdzun gyis rang gzhan gyi mgo skor bar byed pa rnams kyis mthong ba dang*/ spel bar byed na bka' chad drag po chod/ ji bzhin nyams su len cing mos pa rnams bltas pa tsam gyis nyams rtogs thams cad gong 'phel du gyur nas/ tshe gcig lus gcig la rdo rje 'chang 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod dngos grub stsol/ ༈ khrid gzhan rnams na dmigs thun dang rgyab chos tsam ma gtogs dri ba dang ngo sprod zhib pa rnams zhal shes ma dang*/ zur du bkod pa yin la/ 'dir de rnams thams cad phyogs gcig tu gsal por blo dman pas mthong yang bltas chog ma bla ma la lung tsam thob nas zhe thag pa nas nyams len byed rgyu yin na khrid yig 'di ka'i thog nas nyams len bshad tshul dang mthun par skye tshul dang ltag bstun na 'di kas don 'grub cing nyams rtogs skye thag chod/ yang khrid yig gsal ba'i dbang gis rgyud la ma skyes par 'di'i tshig ris la brten rgyud la skyes rgyu ba dang go ba skam po tsam skyes bas chog par bzung na mi chos bla ma'i brdzun du 'gyur zhing*/ rang gis rang bslus par 'gro bas de bzhin spang bar bya/ chos 'di'i bka' srung chos skyong ber nag can gyis mdzod la rang gi rgyud pa mi 'dzin pa dang*/ dam med dang log lta can sogs snod du ma gyur pa rnams kyis mthong ba dang spel na chad pa chod/ chos 'di la spro zhing snod dang ldan pa dang*/

mos gus phul du phyin pa dang nyams len rtse gcig tu sbyong ba rnams kyi srung skyob mdzod/ chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi zhing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob pa'i sdong grogs mdzod/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan gyur shog /maṅga laṃ//
